jobs.title: Staff Program Manager - Tech Learning
jobs.description:
Overview

Come join Intuit's Tech Learning team as a Program Manager. Tech Learning powers Intuit's AI-native builder transformation — training thousands of engineers, PMs, and designers across tools like Claude, Cursor, Figma Make, and Builder.IO. As the team scales its portfolio, we are looking for someone who can turn our day-to-day business of running a learning organization — dashboard/metrics reporting, vendor relationships, budgets, planning rhythms, and readiness for change — into operational excellence, while also delivering on programs that vary from driving Technical talks, Onboarding and all things AI for technical development.

This role is the operational backbone of Tech Learning. You'll own key vendor relationships, support the broader vendor and contractor ecosystem, build and maintain the team's planning and reporting cadence, and lead the operational readiness work that keeps programs launching smoothly and scaling without friction. You'll partner closely with the team and broader Tech Learning leadership to make sure strategy translates into disciplined, repeatable execution.

Responsibilities

Vendor & Budget Management

Own the O'Reilly vendor relationship and support our Udemy partnership to ensure platform utilization.
Support management of the broader learning vendor and contractor ecosystem including end-to-end ownership of contract renewals, usage/utilization tracking, escalations, and performance reviews.
Track and report on vendor spend and accruals; partner with Finance on budget planning, forecasting, and in-year adjustments.
Continuously evaluate vendor ROI and utilization to inform renew/reduce/expand decisions.

Operating Rhythm & Planning

Design and run Tech Learning's operating cadence: leadership reviews, planning cycles, biweekly updates, and reporting rituals
Own and maintain the team's Jira/planning infrastructure (initiatives, epics, workstreams) so leadership always has an accurate view of program status
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that translate raw training data (completions, NPS, adoption) into clear, decision-ready insights for leadership
Establish durable, scalable planning frameworks — not just maintaining the rhythm, but building infrastructure the team can rely on as it grows

Program Support

Collaborate closely with Onboarding Program Manager to support Dev@Intuit, and key onboarding programs and activities.
Collaborate with Program Manager of AI learning to support the deployment of learning experiences.
Partner across the team to develop curriculum and learning bites to support various learning initiatives.

Program & Change Readiness

Lead readiness workstreams for new program launches and major changes (new vendor onboarding, platform migrations, tool rollouts) to ensure smooth, low-friction execution.
Partner with program managers and coordinators to identify risk, drive mitigation, and ensure "definition of done" standards are met before go-live.
Act as connective tissue across Tech Learning, Finance, and cross-functional partners — surfacing issues before they become blockers and bringing data-backed recommendations to the table.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of experience in program management, vendor/procurement management, or a related field
Proficiency in using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) in day-to-day workflows for analysis, reporting, and drafting
Strong organizational skills with a track record of building and running operating rhythms (planning cycles, reporting cadences, leadership reviews).
Experience managing vendor relationships and budgets, including contract renewals, spend tracking, and ROI analysis.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate operational data into clear recommendations for leadership.
Proficiency with Google Suite and program tracking tools (e.g., Jira, or similar).
Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

Preferred

Experience supporting a learning & development, enablement, or Developer Relations organization.
Familiarity with LXP/LMS platforms (Docebo, Degreed) and training vendor ecosystems.
Experience building dashboards or reporting pipelines from raw operational data.

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

San Diego $150,000 - $203,000

Mountain View, CA $158,000- $214,000

jobs.title: Microelectronics - Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Aquatech, we tackle the challenges of critical minerals, water scarcity, and complexity by leveraging technology, expertise, and financing to deliver comprehensive solutions that enable competitive, sustainable infrastructure. As a leading global provider of water and industrial process technology solutions, we help the world's most recognized companies achieve their sustainability and operational goals by implementing innovative approaches for water reuse, desalination, minimal and zero liquid discharge, and critical minerals recovery. Learn more at www.aquatech.com

Aquatech supports some of the world’s most technically demanding industries including semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, solar manufacturing, and data centers. These facilities require highly reliable utility infrastructure including Ultra Pure Water (UPW), wastewater treatment (WWT), reclaim systems, thermal utility systems, chemical systems, and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems.

Aquatech has an immediate need for a full-time Microelectronics Program Manager to support global semiconductor, advanced packaging, solar manufacturing, and data center projects. This role is responsible for providing technical leadership, execution alignment, and integrated project delivery support for highly complex industrial utility systems associated with advanced manufacturing facilities. The successful candidate will possess strong technical and field execution experience across multiple utility disciplines including UPW, WWT, reclaim, thermal systems, process utilities, and ZLD systems. This is a remote position.

Unlike a traditional Project Manager role focused primarily on commercial management and project controls, this position serves as a technical execution leader responsible for engineering integration, managing teams across the globe with discrete scope, delivery schedules, cost targets, startup readiness, operational success, multidisciplinary coordination, and customer technical interface responsibilities across global matrix organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Project Program Leadership

Lead technical execution strategy and program alignment for microelectronics utility infrastructure projects.

Customer facing role that can quickly and effectively communicate the customers needs and request throughout the global organizationCoordinate multidisciplinary technical teams including process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation & controls (I&C), automation, and construction organizations.

Drive technical decision-making, issue resolution, and execution alignment across global execution teams.

Support engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, commissioning, startup, qualification, and operational turnover activities.

Participate in risk mitigation planning, constructability reviews, and execution strategy development.

Support development of scalable execution methodologies, standards, and best practices for microelectronics projects.

Engineering and Execution Support

Review and support development of PFDs, P&IDs, General Arrangements, equipment layouts, utility integration strategies, control philosophies, startup plans, and qualification documentation.

Support engineering coordination between process, mechanical, electrical, automation, controls, and construction disciplines.

Participate in design reviews, operability reviews, maintainability reviews, and technical risk assessments.

Support procurement and vendor technical evaluations for semiconductor and high-tech manufacturing applications.

Evaluate system reliability, redundancy strategies, maintainability, operational flexibility, and lifecycle performance.

Construction, Startup, and Operational Readiness

Coordinate field execution activities including installation reviews, field coordination, commissioning support, startup planning, and operational turnover..

Coordinate closely with construction teams, startup teams, operations organizations, and customers.

Support accelerated startup schedules and schedule recovery efforts as required.

Customer and Organizational Interface

Serve as a customer-facing technical leader for complex microelectronics projects.

Interface directly with semiconductor, advanced packaging, solar manufacturing, and data center customers.

Work effectively within matrix organizations across multiple disciplines and geographies.

Support executive-level customer communications, technical workshops, and design reviews.

Position Differentiation

This position differs from a traditional Project Manager role by focusing heavily on technical execution leadership, multidisciplinary engineering integration, startup and operational readiness, customer technical interface responsibilities, and development of repeatable semiconductor execution methodologies.

Benefits

Aquatech offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, company-paid holidays, and a 401K plan (all benefits are based on eligibility).

Essential Functions

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above and below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Physical Job Demands

Lifting/carrying/moving and exerting up to 50 lbs. of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. May need to climb ladders, cannot be afraid of heights, and will need to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while on site. It involves sitting at a desk for extended periods. Needs a high degree of concentration in a busy area.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Civil, or related discipline).

Minimum Of 10 Years Of Relevant Industrial Experience.

Direct experience supporting one or more of the following industries is required:

Semiconductor manufacturing
Advanced packaging
Solar manufacturing

Strong experience in multiple utility and process systems including UPW, WWT, reclaim systems, thermal utility systems, RO/membrane systems, chemical treatment systems, and ZLD.

Experience supporting large-scale industrial or semiconductor projects through design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, startup, qualification, and operational turnover.

Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering integration and matrix organizational execution.

Strong technical leadership, communication, and troubleshooting capabilities.

Experience with process mechanical systems, piping systems, and utility integration.

Program Manager, Donor Relations

The Program Manager, Donor Relations, oversees a system-wide, comprehensive donor relations program that encourages donor loyalty and repeat and upgraded giving by communicating and celebrating the impact of philanthropy across the health system.

Reporting to the Director, Philanthropy Communications and Donor Relations, the Program Manager, Donor Relations, builds the framework and manages the start-to-end stewardship experience for donors across Endeavor Health’s hospital foundations to drive loyalty, retention and upgraded giving. Serving as the voice of the donor within the Philanthropy Communications team, this role uses data and industry best practices to design structured recognition and reporting cadences. They partner closely with frontline fundraisers to ensure donors feel connected to their impact and collaborate with Philanthropy Communications team to turn stewardship strategies into beautifully executed campaigns, written recognition, and personalized experiences.

Position Highlights

Position: Program Manager, Donor Relations
Location: Evanston, Elmhurst, Naperville, or Arlington Heights, IL
Full Time/Part Time: Full Time (40 hours)
Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5pm
Required Travel: travel to other locations may be required for meetings and events

What You Will Do

Working collaboratively with Philanthropy Communications to write and manage the production of stewardship vehicles that lend consistency and cohesiveness to the identity of the system brand, including acknowledgment templates, endowment reports, impact reports, annual reports, personal stewardship communications for C-suite leadership and top-tier donor engagement, and segmented donor cohort stewardship communications.
Lead standing stewardship meetings with the foundations’ frontline fundraising teams to align on stewardship plans with clear owners and timelines.
Ensure stewardship plans, actions and relationship notes are well documented in donor CRM records. Ensure pledge balances and reminders are coordinated with the Donor Services team and communicated to donors appropriately.
Contribute new ideas to advance the strategic efforts and impact of the program on an ongoing basis.
Manage the upkeep of donor recognition walls and plaques across the hospitals and system locations.
Maintain accurate historical donor files; and update electronic and hardcopy files as applicable to ensure transparent, comprehensive records.
With financial reporting leadership and Philanthropy Operations, ensure system leadership, foundations’ teams and fund managers have timely and accurate details regarding their philanthropic fund balances, fund impact and alignment of donor intent in fund purposes, including special purpose, research and endowment funds.
In tandem with the events team and fundraising partners, inform and contribute to strategic planning and counsel for all stewardship and applicable cultivation events.
In collaboration with Philanthropy Operations and foundation teams, lead updates to policies and procedures to harmonize gift and fiscal policies across the foundations. Create and update Standard Operating Procedures and train on new procedures across the foundation teams.

What You Will Need

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Fundraising, Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
Certification: n/a
Experience:
5+ years in a development office or with related donor relations and stewardship experience is required, along with an inherent joy of working with donors and colleagues to celebrate philanthropy to be successful.
3-5+ years with Salesforce or other CRM is preferred.

Unique or Preferred Skills:
Deep knowledge of best practices in donor relations and stewardship with demonstrated success in developing and executing impactful plans and initiatives that lead to meaningful donor engagement and repeated and increased donor giving.
Proficiency with MS Office and proactively working with Salesforce or similar CRM is strongly preferred.
Tech-savvy and avid learner with a keen interest in fundraising, nonprofit trends, data and donor relations.
Strong written, verbal, organizational, and interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to relate and interact warmly and professionally with individuals from diverse backgrounds, including system leadership, cross-departmental partners, vendors, prospects and discerning donors.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately and with discretion.
Excels in project management: multi-tasking, goal setting, accountability, attention to detail and workload prioritization.
Experience with project management tools and techniques is required.
Experience coordinating budgets, projects and events with vendors is required.
Experience or exposure to basic graphic design tools is a bonus.
Must be flexible and adaptable to changing priorities and proactively address challenges in a fast-paced, emerging and dynamic environment with ongoing deadlines.
Ability to constructively accept and process feedback and a collaborative working style.
Continuously seek ways to improve processes, increase efficiencies and actively pursue professional development opportunities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Membership with Association of Donor Relations Professionals (ADRP) or similar donor relations professional organization preferred

jobs.description:
At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.

This position is with our Adhesive Technologies business unit – where we empower our people to transform industries and provide our customers with a competitive advantage through adhesives, sealants and functional coatings.

Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.

What You´ll Do

Partner with the Head of Automotive Components NAMEX and Leadership Team to support development, execution, and tracking of regional business strategies and growth initiatives.
Drive business performance management through governance of key KPIs, business reviews, executive reporting, and strategic action tracking.
Provide analytical insights and recommendations through financial, commercial, customer, and market analyses to support business decision-making.
Prepare executive-level presentations, business cases, and decision-support materials for senior leadership.
Lead PMO activities for strategic initiatives, transformation programs, and cross-functional projects to ensure timely and successful execution.
Coordinate leadership team governance, business planning processes, and organizational communications, including town halls and management meetings.
Support acquisitions, integrations, and other strategic business development activities, including due diligence, integration governance, and synergy tracking as required.
Drive continuous improvement of management processes, operating rhythms, and governance frameworks to enhance organizational effectiveness.
Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations to align priorities and drive execution of business objectives.
Lead special projects on behalf of regional leadership, supporting growth, transformation, and value-creation initiatives.

What makes you a good fit

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; MBA or Master's degree preferred.
5+ years of experience in strategy, business management, consulting, PMO, finance, commercial excellence, corporate development, or a related field.
Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to connect initiatives to growth, profitability, and value creation.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders in a matrix organization.
Ability to combine strategic thinking with strong execution and project management skills.
Experience preparing executive-level analyses, presentations, and recommendations for senior leadership.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation capabilities.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
High level of ownership, learning agility, resilience, and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.
Ambition and potential to grow into broader business leadership and strategy roles within Henkel.
This position is a hybrid role, with the requirement to work out of our Madison Heights, MI location 40% of your time.

Some benefits of joining Henkel

Health Insurance: affordable plans for medical, dental, vision and wellbeing starting on day 1
Work-Life Balance: Paid time off including sick, vacation, holiday and volunteer time, flexible & hybrid work policies (depending on role), and vacation buy / sell program

Family Support: 12-week gender neutral parental leave (up to 20 weeks for parents giving birth), fertility support, adoption & surrogacy reimbursement, discounted child and elderly care, and scholarships
Career Growth: diverse national and international growth opportunities, access to thousands of skills development courses, and tuition reimbursement

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager - Mid-Market
jobs.description:
Overview

Come join Intuit’s Mid Market Product Development team as a Principal Technical Program Manager. We are seeking a dynamic program leader who excels at driving strategic programs and initiatives across a complex, cross-functional organization — someone who brings structure, momentum, and clarity to the work that matters most. You will lead high-impact programs from strategy through delivery, ensuring cross-functional alignment at every stage and translating organizational priorities into measurable outcomes.

You will operate across the full breadth of the Mid Market organization, building trusted partnerships with leaders at all levels, driving operating rhythms that keep teams moving with speed and purpose, and stepping into ambiguity with confidence to bring order and direction. If you are passionate about solving complex customer problems at scale and energized by the challenge of making large, diverse teams work as one, we would love to have you on our team.

Responsibilities

Portfolio & Strategic Leadership

Partner with Portfolio Leadership to unblock program teams and guide delivery across a broad and complex program portfolio.
Connect the dots across various programs to simplify the “why, what, and how” for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Influence prioritization and tradeoff discussions across Product and Engineering leaders to ensure teams focus on the highest-impact work.
Leverage AI tools and data insights to streamline program operations and accelerate execution velocity

Cross-Domain Execution & Dependency Leadership

Lead cross-team dependency forums across engineering domains, driving horizontal alignment across Mid Market PD teams and partners.
Define and implement program frameworks and consistent operating cadences to ensure teams deliver with velocity and ease.
Identify and proactively manage risks, dependencies, architectural misalignment, and execution bottlenecks — driving data-informed decisions to resolution.
Drive cross-functional execution across multiple scrum teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, roles, and outcomes.

Roadmapping & Planning

jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. With approximately 100 million customers worldwide using products such as TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp, we believe that everyone should have the opportunity to prosper. We never stop working to find new, innovative ways to make that possible.

Job Overview

The Intuit Business Operations team is a high-performing team focused on enterprise-level planning, running the company operating system, evolving KPI frameworks, delivering data and insights through dashboards, and driving transformation projects. The team’s vision is to make Intuit a world-class execution machine through a more activist role, end-to-end planning, and metric-driven rigor in service to accelerated growth and realization of strategy.

We are looking for strong strategic problem-solvers who possess the ability to analyze and connect the dots between multitudes of data, influence how we operate the business through strong partnership, and act with a bias for action to ultimately drive tangible business impact. As a Business Operations Staff, you will work alongside executive leaders to provide thought leadership and drive transformation projects and initiatives. You will also have an opportunity to work across the broader communities (e.g. Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Analytics) to help innovate and drive change in how we operate.

Responsibilities

Provide thought leadership in identifying opportunities to drive operational excellence
Analyze company-level performance and operational data to provide insights and actionable recommendations
Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams (e.g. Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Analytics) to jointly problem solve and develop solutions to complex business problems
Lead strategic initiatives or projects end-to-end from initial hypotheses to recommendation to operationalization
Design and implement frameworks and operating models that accelerate operational excellence, decision-making, and best practices
Learn from internal and external best practices and work with business leaders to implement and scale them across the company

Qualifications

4-6 years of relevant experience in delivering significant strategic and operational impact across a technology company or large organization, SaaS or fintech preferred
Strategy and operations experience at a high-growth startup, management consulting experience, or strategic/analytical roles at large companies
Proven track record in leveraging data, developing insight-backed hypotheses and driving learning plans to build compelling business cases
Excellent quantitative analytical skills, creativity in problem solving, and a keen business sense with the ability to generate innovative insights, ideas, and opportunities that drive tangible business outcomes
Ownership mindset with an ability to convert strategic plans into actions, drive projects to completion, and sweat the details to deliver the outcome
Experienced change management leader who is able to influence and build trust across a highly cross-functional organization (peers, working teams, and executives) to accelerate outcomes
Excellent communicator with strong presentation skills and compelling storytelling abilities; feel very comfortable leading and facilitating workshops business reviews with executives and teams
Demonstrated ability to come up to speed quickly on new business domains
Strong academic record required. MBA or equivalent from a nationally recognized institution required.
Preferred: Proven experience building AI solutions or automating workflows

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $166,500 - $225,500

Review and approve low-level designs (LLDs) and implementation runbooks before execution.

Serve as escalation point for complex in-flight technical issues; engage hands-on when warranted while ensuring the team learns from every resolution.
Champion Zero Trust and SASE architecture principles within ECI’s implementation workflows.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

Own implementation status communication to client stakeholders; translate technical risk into clear business impact language.
Represent the implementation team in internal delivery reviews, capacity planning, and service improvement forums.
Maintain ECI’s documentation standard across implementation plans, network diagrams, as-built records, and configuration baselines — ensuring clean handoffs to managed services teams.

Qualifications

Required

10+ years of progressive network engineering experience with a demonstrable track record in enterprise implementation, ideally within an MSP or multi-client environment.
3+ years of direct people management — you have hired engineers, set goals, handled performance, and actively developed talent.
Deep technical proficiency in Cisco networking (Catalyst, Nexus, IOS-XE/XR), Palo Alto firewalls (App-ID, Threat Prevention, VPN, Panorama), and wireless (WLC, Meraki MR/MS/MX).
Strong working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), VLANs, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6 fundamentals.
Proven ability to run multiple concurrent implementation projects with accountability for schedules, resources, and stakeholder communication.
Solid understanding of security frameworks, compliance standards, and change management governance in regulated client environments.

Preferred

Active CCNP, CCIE, or PCNSE certification; equivalent demonstrated expertise considered.
Experience with SD-WAN (Cisco Viptela, VeloCloud) and SASE / Zero Trust architecture in client deployments.
Familiarity with automation tooling (Python, Ansible) to drive repeatability and reduce manual effort across the team.
Experience with network monitoring platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, Meraki Insights) and using telemetry data to drive delivery quality.
Hedge fund, financial services, or similarly regulated client-facing environment experience is a strong plus.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.

Communicates expectations without ambiguity and follows through consistently. Leads with clarity.
Engineers respect them because they know the stack — not just the title. Commands technical credibility.
Holds the team and themselves to high execution standards without micromanaging. Drives accountability.
Focused on delivery quality and reliability, not just activity volume. Solves for client outcomes.

connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

Collaborate cross-functionally to deploy production AI agents for strategic customers within 90 days, accelerating revenue and directly shaping our scalable product roadmap. Partner across Sales, Product, and Engineering to prove technical value, working hands-on with voice AI, integrations, and real customer data.

Turn field insights into platform capabilities that scale, ensuring every deployment makes the next one faster. Your work directly accelerates revenue and shapes the product roadmap.

About The Team

We deploy Zoom Virtual Agent into live customer environments. Our team bridges Sales and Engineering through hands-on technical validation. We exist to convert pilots into production systems.

Responsibilities

Designing and deploying production-ready AI agents during proof-of-concept engagements, integrating with customer CRMs, telephony systems, and knowledge bases using Python and TypeScript.
Engineering voice experiences by tuning speech synthesis, turn-taking, and barge-in across providers to match customer requirements and call profiles.
Building evaluation frameworks with scripted tasks and adversarial scenarios that measure resolution rate, containment, and customer satisfaction as deployment gates.
Capturing product gaps and contributing structured feedback to Engineering, generalising field solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
Transitioning successful pilots to Professional Services or partners with clear documentation, playbooks, and recommendations for ongoing operation.

What We’re Looking For

Demonstrate 4+ years in customer-facing technical roles shipping complex SaaS or AI/ML solutions (Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, or similar).
Deploy LLM-based agents with tool use, multi-step orchestration, and guardrails into production customer environments.
Apply voice stack expertise across ASR, TTS, turn-taking, and barge-in, including tuning at least one major provider (ElevenLabs, Azure, Cartesia, or similar).
Build production integrations in Python with working knowledge of TypeScript or Go, connecting enterprise systems such as CRMs and telephony platforms.
Write tests, log failures, and iterate against measurable targets to validate agent performance before go-live.
Communicate technical concepts to business and engineering stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
Bring contact centre domain knowledge (Genesys, Five9, NICE, Zoom Contact Center) or experience with AI agent platforms (Decagon, Sierra, or similar).
Contribute to voice agent benchmarks, open-source projects, or have experience deploying in regulated industries (healthcare, financial services, telecom).

jobs.title: Staff Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Come join the Intuit Expert Network Team as a Staff Program Manager driving readiness for changes impacting our customer success expert ecosystem. Our AI-driven platform and network of Intuit experts includes thousands of diverse and talented experts around the world who are skilled at using our products and in their professional disciplines as tax attorneys, credentialed tax/accounting experts, and bookkeepers. In this exciting role, you will collaborate across multiple teams to enable awesome experiences and operational efficiencies.

As a Staff Program Manager, you will lead the work to ensure our experts are prepared and changes are implemented with excellence so that our teams can delight our customers. Successful candidates will have prior change management experience and are highly passionate about improving processes and collaborating across teams to drive change at scale, with high velocity and adoption.

Responsibilities

Manage a portfolio of initiatives and ensure appropriate readiness workstreams are identified, plans are developed and seamlessly executed to our “Definition of Done” standard to create an excellent experience for experts amidst change
Assess risk across workstreams and drive appropriate mitigation efforts, prioritization, and tradeoffs, resulting in on-time releases with high adoption and no/minimal defects
Partner with product and communication teams to understand roadmaps and proactively communicate changes
Validate readiness, oversee release and evaluate how a change is performing, where there may be opportunities for improvement
Seek opportunities to continually optimize, including improving speed and clarity of how we deliver change and ensure planning and change practices are enduring and scalable.
Partner, educate, roadshow and mentor others on change management best practices
Role model expert advocacy translate expert insights (quantitative and qualitative) into action for support readiness work from inception through post implementation

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; MBA a plus or equivalent experience
3-5 years of proven performance in change management
7+ years of program or project management experience
Proficient with Google Suite (documents, spreadsheets, presentations)
Excellent written and verbal and communication skills
Superb organizational skills and can demonstrate successful management of multiple projects at a time, delivering quality outcomes tied to business outcomes
Sought after strategic partner, able to build and nurture strong relations and influence broadly
Experienced in using AI for streamlining business tasks
Lean, Six Sigma experience a plus

jobs.title: AML OVERSIGHT & FINANCIAL INTELLIGENCE Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit is seeking a strategic and operationally excellent Head of AML Oversight & Financial Intelligence to join its AML Office. Reporting directly to the Enterprise AML/BSA Officer, this senior leader will manage a team of financial intelligence professionals responsible for global AML investigations, suspicious activity analysis, regulatory reporting, and liaising with law enforcement.

Intuit's money and AML-regulated products span three of the world's most recognized consumer and small business financial brands. Through QuickBooks, Intuit offers business banking, payments, payroll, bill pay, lines of credit and lending products and other services to small and mid-sized businesses across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland. Through TurboTax, Intuit provides consumer tax preparation in the United States and Canada with integrated financial services including tax refund advances and associated payment flows. Through Credit Karma, Intuit serves tens of millions of consumers in the United States and United Kingdom with personal finance products including bank accounts, savings, credit cards, loans, and money movement. Collectively, these products operate under the AML/CFT supervisory frameworks of FinCEN and U.S. state regulators, FINTRAC, the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), the Central Bank of Ireland, and applicable EU Anti-Money Laundering Directives.

This is a rare opportunity to mature and lead a best-in-class financial crimes intelligence program at a globally scaled, multi-brand fintech — one that integrates the analytical rigor of a traditional financial intelligence unit with the speed, data-driven discipline, and technological agility demanded by Intuit's consumer and business product ecosystem.

Core Program Areas Include

Investigations & Reporting

SAR/STR Filings and Quality Assurance
AML Transaction Monitoring — Alert, Case & Filing Queue Management
High-Risk Customer Reviews and Relationship Decisioning
Complex Financial Crimes Investigations
Law Enforcement Inquiries and Legal Process Response
Grand Jury Subpoenas, 314(b) Requests, and Voluntary Information Sharing

Regulatory Programs & Oversight

314(a) and FinCEN/FINTRAC Regulatory Programs
Sponsor Bank Relationship Management and Compliance Integration
Contractual AML Obligations Across Money Movement Products
AML Vendor Oversight and Technology Governance
Regulatory Examination Support and Findings Remediation

Responsibilities

Financial Intelligence Program Leadership

Enhance, scale and continuously mature Intuit's financial intelligence capabilities, including the operational infrastructure for case management, analytical rigor, suspicious activity identification, and intelligence-led investigations. Enhance written policies, procedures, and playbooks that codify the operational program.

Review, enhance and govern investigation workflow standards, escalation matrices, and case closure criteria
Collaborate with the team to build and manage a financial intelligence library of typologies, red-flag indicators, and trend analyses relevant to Intuit's product lines
Analyze trends and risks for senior leadership, the Board, and regulators
Own and evolve the SAR/STR quality assurance framework to ensure narrative quality, regulatory completeness, and timely filing
Investigations — Complex Cases & Senior Escalation

Serve as the ultimate internal escalation point for high-risk, high-complexity, or jurisdictionally novel financial crimes cases. Ensure defensible, thoroughly documented, and timely resolution of escalated matters.

Lead or directly supervise investigations involving potential terrorism financing, sanctions nexus, public corruption, or novel fraud-AML intersections
Make or approve final SAR/STR filing decisions, including voluntary and mandatory filings, and escalations to banking partners.
Maintain a documented escalation and second-look review process auditable by regulators and examiners
Operational Excellence, Automation & Technology Enablement

Drive measurable efficiency, quality, and scalability across AML operations through aggressive adoption of automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven management. This role is expected to be a visible champion for technology-enabled compliance — actively seeking opportunities to eliminate manual work, accelerate detection, and improve the quality and defensibility of AML outcomes.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

Strategic Leadership & Talent Cultivation. Assemble and guide AML specialists, investigators, and analysts, ensuring seamless integration with operational units and strategic partners. Cultivate an organizational climate rooted in analytical rigor, proactive ownership, and collaborative safety.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

Minimum 10–15 years of progressive experience in AML, BSA, financial crimes compliance, or financial intelligence, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
Deep, practitioner-level knowledge of BSA/AML regulations and demonstrated experience implementing and administering these requirements in-house
Significant hands-on experience with SAR/STR filing programs, including quality assurance, narrative standards, and regulatory dialogue with FinCEN, FINTRAC, or equivalent bodies
Demonstrated experience managing law enforcement liaison functions, including responses to subpoenas, emergency requests, and voluntary information sharing
Track record of leading complex, multi-variable financial crimes investigations, including matters with sanctions, PEP, or terrorism financing dimensions
Experience managing or overseeing regulatory money movement programs, including 314(a) and sponsor bank compliance
Proven ability to design and govern AML programs across multiple jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, EU/UK strongly preferred)
Experience engaging directly with financial regulators in an examination, enforcement, or supervisory context
Strong analytical capability: ability to synthesize large data sets and investigation outputs into strategic intelligence products
Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience

Other Qualifications

CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist) certification; CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner) or CFCS (Certified Financial Crimes Specialist) a plus
Experience with fintech, payments, payroll, tax-adjacent, or consumer financial products; familiarity with the QuickBooks, TurboTax, or Credit Karma product ecosystems is a meaningful plus
Working knowledge of BSA/AML, GDPR, CCPA, and cross-border privacy constraints on AML information sharing

Footer

This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Responsibilities

Noblis ESI is seeking a Junior Threat Analysis (Intel) Specialist
to provide support to space operations mission functions in an integrated space operations center environment located in Fort Belvoir, Virginia.

The selected candidate will support threat analysis activities spanning all-source intelligence analysis, counterspace operations assessment, and mission partner coordination across NRO, USSPACECOM, the Combatant Commands, and the broader Intelligence Community. Working under the guidance of senior intelligence professionals, this role will contribute to the development and maintenance of accurate and timely threat assessments to support space and counterspace operations decision-making.

Responsibilities Include

Conduct all-source intelligence analysis in support of multi-domain (space, terrestrial, cyber) space and counterspace operations threat assessments.
Monitor and assess intelligence reporting from multiple IC sources to identify risk to mission.
Identify intelligence gaps and intelligence and collection requirements to reduce intelligence gaps related to space and counterspace operations.
Maintain the operations center Common Intelligence Picture by providing timely and accurate threat analysis products related to risk to the space mission.
Support briefings and presentations of threat assessments to operations staff and senior personnel.
As directed, collaborate with USSPACECOM, USSF, NRO, and IC partners to ensure integrated threat analysis support.
Support the development and implementation of intelligence TTPs for space threat analysis.
Maintain awareness of current and emerging threats to space systems and operations.
Perform research and analysis on adversary space capabilities, intentions, and activities.
Support senior analysts in the production of organization threat and risk assessment reports.

US Citizenship is required.

Familiarity with all-source intelligence analysis methodologies and tools.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to convey intelligence assessments clearly.

Experience with NRO MGS/IC operations.
Familiarity with USSPACECOM and USSF operational processes.
Basic understanding of orbital mechanics and satellite operations.

Are you interested in making a difference in the lives of fellow Californians while achieving your career goals? The mission of the California Department of Social Services is to serve, protect, and support the people of California experiencing need in ways that empower wellbeing and disrupt systemic inequities. The vision of the California Department of Social Services is to provide quality services with a commitment to an inclusive, diverse, and equitable California where all people can thrive.

The California Department of Social Services (CDSS) launched the Research, Automation and Data Division (RADD) to build a sustainable data culture and maximize the full value of CDSS data assets. RADD is responsible for working with Information Services (technology) and Program partners throughout the data life cycle to ensure best practices are elevated toward the goal of serving California's most vulnerable families using a human-centered and data-driven approach.

CDSS Guiding Principles

Diversity. Equity. Inclusion. Accessibility. Belonging.

Quality Services

Data Defined Outcomes

As an RDA II in the Data Solutions Unit, you will participate in meetings with programs to learn about their data problems and help build solutions to address them. Common examples of our work include modernizing data collection, automating workflows, and creating low-code apps that simplify complex processes.

The key to succeeding in this role is a willingness to learn, both about CDSS programs’ needs and new technical skills. A successful RDA II will acquire a deep understanding of programs’ processes, the ability to identify pain points, and the technical skills to create innovative solutions.

The specific solutions we create vary by project and our software options are growing, so flexibility and the capacity to learn through shadowing, meetings, project documentation, and online trainings are more important for this role than preexisting knowledge. All work will be done under the direction of the RDS I Supervisor and in conjunction with other team members as the RDA II learns our developing technology stack and how it can be used to serve CDSS programs.

jobs.title: Risk Operations Manager 3
jobs.description:
Overview

FinTech powers the money movement capabilities within Intuit, and we are seeking an exceptional operational risk leader to join our Fintech Risk Operations organization as a Manager 3/ Group Manager. The ideal candidate will have a background in leading dynamic organizations in the fraud/financial crimes operational space (preferably within a Fintech company),and will have a passion for growing and developing team members. If you excel at balancing complex risk mitigation while providing exceptional customer experiences, are driven by continuous improvement, love developing people, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then this role is for you.

Your core responsibility will be to lead a large organization in achieving critical KPIs related to the investigation and resolution of complex risk alerts. You will directly oversee multiple teams making high-stakes decisions regarding financial risk mitigation for our money movement products, encompassing compliance, fraud, and financial risks. Your key focus areas will include inspiring, developing, and mentoring our most skilled individual contributors, managers, and senior managers who in turn will coach and support frontline teams, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to ensure operational excellence and metric achievement. This role will balance operational oversight with a hands-on proactive approach to flourish in a rapidly changing environment.

This is a hybrid role that requires on-site work approximately at least days per week to foster collaboration and strong working relationships. Domestic travel may be required up to 10% of the time, especially during the initial onboarding period. The ability to work extended hours during peak fraud analysis periods is essential.

Responsibilities

Lead and empower a large organization (70-100+) of risk investigators, fostering a culture of ownership and driving continuous improvement across the organization. Directly manage complex fraud tactical teams, including assessment, quantification, and implementation of operational detection and mitigation strategies.
Proactively drive operational effectiveness through goal definition, KPI assessment (e.g. quality, handle time, and service level commitments), and continuous improvement to achieve all audit and control requirements and business KPIs.
Advocate for our customer by sharing the impact of friction points on our customers, considering risk, customer behaviors and the customer impact when making risk decisions.
Utilize data-driven insights to assess and track KPIs, measure program effectiveness, and identify and develop compelling business cases to simplify fraud detection, streamline operational response efforts, and reduce fraud/risk occurrences.
Collaborate with senior leadership (e.g. Operations Director and Chief Risk Officer) to align on strategic vision and contribute to organizational direction and cross functionally to ensure KPI achievement.
Develop and maintain expertise in all financial products and risk factors, to stay informed of industry trends and actively contribute to the Risk Management community.
Contribute to operational policy development and prioritize initiatives that drive improvements in risk detection, risk mitigation, or our customer experience.
Demonstrate exceptional leadership by inspiring and developing personnel, upholding integrity and professionalism standards, and exhibiting personal composure during crisis management.
Conduct in-depth investigations of risk-based anomalies, leveraging investigation results and personal expertise to make high stakes decisions.

Qualifications

Domain Expertise: 7+ years of proven experience in fraud investigations, underwriting, risk operations, or a related field within the e-commerce, banking, or financial services industry.
Operational Leadership: 5+ years of experience in Risk Operations, preferably within Fintech, including 3+ years leading teams of 50+ (individual contributors and managers) to ultimately exceed performance goals.
Strategic Mindset: A demonstrated strategic thinker who translates business objectives into actionable plans, achieving measurable success in a complex environment.
Decision Making: Exercises sound risk-based judgment and customer impact to determine and execute effective solutions within dynamic, evolving environments. Exhibits meticulous attention to detail, sophisticated critical thinking, and robust organizational skills essential for adaptability and success.
Communication and Influence: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with a proven track record of building strong relationships and influencing decision-making across all organizational levels. Delivers difficult messages effectively, synthesizes complex information into clear recommendations, and uses compelling narratives to drive positive change in risk operations practices.
Strong Execution Skills: Proven ability to lead and execute complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders, effectively prioritizing projects and deadlines based on criticality and risk to maximize impact.
Data Fluency: Strong analytical acumen and proven ability to use data (dashboards, ad-hoc reports, and spreadsheets) to identify problems, inform strategic decisions, and assess the impact of operational processes.
Stakeholder Management: Expertly navigates conflicting stakeholder interests, builds strong and collaborative relationships, and effectively influences stakeholders at all levels within a cross-functional or matrixed environment to drive alignment and results.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related field such as Accounting, Finance, Data, or Criminal Justice and/or industry certifications preferred.

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

jobs.description:
Job Mission / Purpose:

The Program Manager, Product Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Affairs (PEC & RA) Global Logistics Operations (GLO) is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing global Regulatory Affairs and Product Environmental Compliance programs applicable to Global Logistics activities and distribution networks.

This role ensures that GLO Operations—including EU and global distribution centers —are compliant with applicable regulatory requirements related to environmental product compliance, packaging, batteries, and Economic Operator obligations. The Program Manager acts as the primary interface between GLO, Corporate RA/PEC programs, and cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure timely, consistent, and compliant implementation of regulatory requirements.

Key Activities & Responsibilities

Leading global RA & PEC programs applicable to Global Logistics, ensuring alignment with Corporate and Divisional regulatory strategies and timelines.
Establishing and maintaining program governance, including scope definition, milestones, risk management, dependency tracking, and executive reporting.
Coordinating implementation of Product Environmental Compliance (PEC) requirements impacting logistics and distribution activities, including packaging, batteries, and restricted substances.
Act as the official correspondent or responsible person to relevant health authorities for GLO sites.
Evaluating impact of changing global regulations, including PEC requirements, on the GLO network and communicating impact to leadership.
Supporting compliance with applicable regulations such as Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (PPWR), Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (BWBR), and related implementing acts.
Report on budget actuals and project costs to management for activities supporting regulatory requirements.
Training staff on, executing and monitoring registration and listing obligations for GLO sites globally.
Supporting health authority and notified body audits as required and responding to health authority queries.
Collaborating with Regulatory Affairs function to identify, draft and communicate device shortages to relevant health authorities.
Coordinating RA‑related Economic Operator obligations (Importer and Distributor) as they apply to GLO operations, in close collaboration with Corporate RA and Legal.
Acting as the primary GLO liaison to Corporate PEC and RA programs to ensure consistent interpretation, deployment, and execution across regions.
Partnering with Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Packaging Engineering, Sustainability, Operations, and Business stakeholders to drive end‑to‑end regulatory readiness.
Ensuring appropriate regulatory documentation, evidence, and records are maintained to support audits, inspections, and market access requirements.
Monitoring program performance through defined KPIs and readiness indicators, identifying gaps and driving timely corrective actions.
Supporting continuous improvement of regulatory and compliance processes within Global Logistics.
Promoting awareness of regulatory and environmental compliance requirements throughout the GLO organization.

Education

Hon. Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering or related subject or equivalency is mandatory.
Masters degree in Science, Engineering or related subject is preferred.
Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) in medical devices is preferred.

Experience

8+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Product Environmental Compliance, or regulatory program management within a regulated industry (medical devices preferred).
Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross‑functional, global programs.
Working knowledge of EU environmental, packaging, and battery regulations and their impact on logistics and distribution activities.
Experience working within ISO 13485 / MDR / FDA‑regulated quality systems.
Experience supporting distribution, logistics, or supply chain activities is preferred.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Business Analyst

Reporting to:
Logistics Excellence Manager

The Role

As our Business Analyst, you’ll turn operational data into clear, meaningful insight that supports better decisions across our waste management operations.

You’ll extract and combine data from internal systems, analyse business performance and present your findings in a way that is easy for non-technical stakeholders to understand. Working closely with operational teams and managers, you’ll help identify trends, highlight opportunities for improvement and provide evidence-based answers to key business questions.

This is a hands-on, data-focused role for someone who enjoys working with numbers and can connect analysis to real operational and commercial outcomes. Joining Panda at an important stage of growth, you’ll help us move from data to insight—and from insight to action.

What You’ll Be Doing

As Business Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

Extracting, consolidating and analysing data from internal business systems
Working with large operational datasets to identify trends, patterns and performance issues
Translating complex information into clear and concise reports for non-technical stakeholders
Working with managers and operational teams to understand their reporting and information needs
Providing analysis to support operational, financial and strategic decision-making
Combining information from different systems to create a complete view of business performance
Responding to ad hoc requests and providing clear, evidence-based answers to business questions
Highlighting areas where performance, efficiency or service delivery could be improved
Contributing to the continued development of reporting and analytical capabilities across the department

What We’re Looking For

To succeed as Business Analyst, you’ll need:

Previous experience in a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst or similar data-focused role
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables and working with large datasets
Experience using Power BI or another business intelligence or reporting platform
The ability to explain data and findings clearly to a non-technical audience
Strong organisational and time-management skills
The ability to prioritise competing requests and adapt in a fast-paced environment
A positive, collaborative approach and a willingness to support continuous improvement
Commercial awareness and an understanding that effective analysis should lead to better business decisions

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have

Experience working with logistics, transport or waste management operations
Experience analysing large operational datasets
An understanding of customer service standards and service-level expectations
Basic knowledge of health and safety requirements within a transport or depot environment

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Business Analyst to become a trusted source of insight and contribute directly to the ongoing growth and development of Panda.

About You

About Us

We are Panda. We value waste.

We’re in the business of waste management but that doesn’t just mean collecting bins. Behind every collection is a passionate team of people finding smarter, safer, and more sustainable ways to recycle and repurpose materials that would otherwise go to waste.

Over the past 30 years, Panda has grown into a leading resource recovery business, bringing together almost 3,000 people across multiple brands, united by a shared vision and strong values. While our operations are diverse, our purpose is clear: to protect our people, support our customers, and create positive impact for the communities and environments we serve.

At Panda, people are at the heart of everything we do
. We work as one team, combining different skills, experiences, and perspectives to achieve shared goals. We care for each other’s wellbeing, encourage development, and support growth because we know we’re stronger together.

We expect excellence
in how we operate. High standards, bold thinking, and continuous improvement drive our passion for innovation. We challenge the ordinary, put safety first, and embrace new ideas while delivering practical, cost-effective solutions that move our business forward.

We own what we do
. From day-to-day tasks to major projects, we take pride in our work and responsibility for the outcome. We don’t walk past problems we address them together. Our expertise, reliability, and care reflect who we are and the difference we make.

And above all, we act with trust and integrity
. Trust is built through open communication, honesty, and accountability. It allows us to move quickly, make confident decisions, and deliver results — knowing our people are empowered to do the right thing.

Our journey depends on talented, committed people who want to make an impact.

Take the first step and join us on the journey.

Panda is committed to attracting and retaining a skilled and diverse workforce that reflects the communities in which we operate and the people we serve.

You will work closely with engineering, IT, and operations teams to translate raw machine telemetry into actionable business insights, driving efficiency, reducing downtime, and scaling our automated processes.

Develop and maintain KPIs and operational dashboards (e.g., Overall Equipment Effectiveness - OEE) to provide visibility to stakeholders. Translate complex machine data, with support of engineering teams, into clear, actionable business recommendations for leadership.

jobs.title: Data Analyst III(Network Traffic Analytics)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Iridium is an award-winning and innovative satellite communications company with bragging rights to the only network that offers voice and data connectivity anywhere in the world. For over 20 years, Iridium’s unique network and services have supported critical communications needs for individuals, businesses, and the evolving Internet of Things.

At Iridium, we understand the importance of staying connected and the limitations of traditional communications networks. People across the globe, including first responders, humanitarians, global militaries, scientific researchers, and lone workers, as well as ships, aircraft and remote operations all rely on Iridium to stay connected. We take our responsibility for providing these essential communications very seriously and pride ourselves on offering a reliable lifeline when needed. Likewise, Iridium is committed to providing an exciting and innovative workplace, where employees are challenged to think outside the box and collaborate on new, bold ideas and solutions. Our talented teams are passionate about their work and the impact our company makes around the world. Iridium fosters an empowering and inclusive culture that allows employees to genuinely be their best selves. We are looking for others who want to join this truly unique company that celebrates our employees and provides the opportunity to truly make a difference in the world.

What We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a skilled and analytical Data Analyst III to help understand and improve the performance of our satellite telecommunications network. In this role, you will analyze network traffic, service quality, usage trends, and operational data to identify patterns, investigate issues, and support data-driven decision making across the organization. Working with satellite network, RF, systems engineering, operations, customer-facing, and data teams, you will collect, analyze, and visualize data from multiple sources to help explain network behavior and support operational improvements. The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large datasets using SQL, Power BI, Snowflake, and other analytical tools. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, effective communication, and a willingness to develop expertise in satellite telecommunications and network operations.

What You’ll Do:

Analyze satellite telecommunications network data to identify trends, anomalies, service issues, and usage patterns that impact network performance or customer experience.
Investigate operational and customer questions by querying and analyzing data using SQL, Snowflake, Power BI, and other analytical tools.
Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate network performance metrics, operational trends, and key findings to technical and business stakeholders.
Analyze network telemetry, call detail records (CDRs), session data, RF metrics, gateway performance, device usage, and other operational datasets.
Collaborate with RF Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations, and Data Engineering teams to validate data, improve reporting accuracy, and support operational initiatives.
Build analytical datasets, semantic models, reports, and visualizations that support investigation, monitoring, root-cause analysis, executive communication, and customer-facing explanation.
Monitor key performance indicators such as throughput, latency, call success rates, beam utilization, gateway performance, and traffic trends.
Assist with capacity analysis by evaluating utilization patterns and identifying areas that may require further investigation or planning.
Confidently communicate findings through concise written summaries, presentations, Power BI reports, and ad hoc analysis; tailor the level of technical detail to executive, engineering, operational, or customer audiences.
Develop deep domain knowledge of Iridium's business, products, satellite architecture, network operations, customer usage patterns, and data landscape.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Typically requires 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, telecommunications, or a related analytical role.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, aggregation strategy, temporal analysis, query troubleshooting, and the ability to work with large-scale data sets.
Strong Power BI skills, including data modeling, DAX, report design for analysis, drillthrough/drilldown, performance-aware semantic model design, and the ability to build reports that support investigation rather than only static reporting.
Experience analyzing operational, network, telecommunications, or other high-volume datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and performance issues.
Possess an analytical mindset, with the ability to understand a situation or problem and think critically to make decisions or come up with solutions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and to answer direct questions from senior leaders or external customers.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams and set priorities without guidance.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to confidently present products, deliverables, analyses, and/or issues
High intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn a complex technical domain without extensive oversight.

Things That Would be Great if You Brought to the Table:

Experience in telecom, satellite communications, wireless networks, RF systems, network operations, or network quality/performance analytics.
Familiarity with RF/network concepts such as beams, channels, gateways, congestion, handover, link quality, signal strength, dropped sessions, capacity, availability, or quality of service.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis, anomaly detection, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, or machine-learning techniques, with the ability to choose practical methods appropriate to the business question.
Analytical engineering experience, including building curated marts, reusable metric layers, data quality checks, or pipelines with tools such as dbt or similar frameworks.

We’ll also need you to:

Be able to work in the office at least 60% of the time (3 or more days a week) to foster collaboration with the team and stakeholders
Be able to travel up 10%
Be a US Citizen

Work Environment:

This position primarily works in an office setting and is largely sedentary with the majority of the position working with a computer. The role typically requires the use of basic office equipment such as a phone, video, computer, keyboard, mouse, and printer.

We believe in-person connection drives innovation, strengthens mentorship, and builds culture, while flexibility enables employees to do their best work. Under Iridium’s Hybrid Work Policy, employees are expected to work at least three days per week (approximately 60%) in an Iridium office to support collaboration, relationship-building, and professional growth.

Additional Information

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work for this role and is not a comprehensive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be assigned additional responsibilities as needed.

Base Pay Range: $95,000 - $125,000 USD

Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors and this range represents an estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Base salary is only one part of our compensation package for this role. You may also be eligible for company stock and annual bonus. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role that succeeds through influence, disciplined communication, and data rather than direct authority. The Program Manager works directly with product owners and cross-functional project teams to keep high-stakes initiatives on track, and gives leadership a real-time, honest picture of progress across the organization's most important product bets.

What You'll Do

Manage and Report on Key Strategic Initiatives

Manage and support key large-scale product projects. Actively manage progress on the organization's strategic product initiatives including product modernization, AI/ML integration, and other transformational, multi-quarter projects as examples, partnering closely with product owners and project teams to keep work moving against plan.
Own status reporting to leadership. Build and maintain accurate, timely, executive-ready status reports and dashboards for key projects, giving leadership a clear, consolidated view of progress, milestones, budget/resourcing status, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.
Track project health and key metrics. Define and monitor the milestones, KPIs, and success metrics for each large-scale initiative, translating detailed project activity into concise, decision-ready insight for leadership and flagging projects that are off track.

Keep Initiatives On Track

Identify and escalate risks and issues. Proactively identify risks, issues, blockers, and cross-team dependencies threatening a project's scope, schedule, or quality; maintain a clear view of open items and escalate to leadership with recommended paths forward.
Run project governance and cadence. Establish and facilitate a regular cadence of project reviews and checkpoints with project teams and leadership ensuring each key initiative has a consistent forum for reporting progress, making decisions, and resolving blockers.
Drive accountability across project teams. Hold project owners and cross-functional contributors (engineering, design, product marketing, product management, sales, customer success) accountable to committed timelines and deliverables, following up on action items and unresolved issues between checkpoints.

Communicate and Support Decision-Making

Communicate with stakeholders. Tailor communication of project status and impact for different audiences, from individual project teams to senior executives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned throughout each initiative's lifecycle.
Support prioritization and planning. Provide leadership with the visibility needed to make informed trade-off and sequencing decisions across the portfolio of large-scale initiatives, based on current progress, risk, and resourcing.

Who You'll Work With

Product Management, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, as well as the Product leadership team. Required

Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3–5 years of program or project management experience.
Demonstrated experience managing and reporting on the progress of strategic projects from initiation through delivery.
Hands-on proficiency using AI tools for program management and reporting.

Proven ability to build clear, accurate, executive-level status reports and dashboards and to present project progress confidently to senior leadership.
Experience identifying, tracking, and escalating project risks, issues, and dependencies, and driving resolution with cross-functional teams.

Experience managing large-scale, complex, or transformational initiatives in a software/SaaS or technology environment.
Experience in a large, multi-product software organization or a portfolio shaped by mergers and acquisitions, where products operate with a high degree of autonomy.
Familiarity with ERP or vertical-market/industry-specific software.
Experience working within or alongside a Product Management organization with product roadmaps and release processes.
Experience presenting project updates to senior executive audiences.

Performance is measured on a paired set of leading and outcome indicators across the role:

Reporting reliability. Timeliness, accuracy, and leadership-rated trustworthiness of status reporting and dashboards for key strategic initiatives.
Risk visibility. Early identification and escalation of risks and issues — measured by how often problems are surfaced in time for leadership to act, rather than discovered after the fact.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

r to lead the end-to-end technical delivery of our development programs. In this role, you will own technical planning and cross-functional execution to ensure program success. Success in this position hinges on three key facets:

Systems and engineering mindset - the ability to understand and assess technical concept. Identifying system dependencies, interfaces, technical risks and the impact of key architectural decisions with the engineering team.
Execution focused - digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program management, and leadership skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.
Collaborative partnership - managing customer relationships and shaping the future of the program with the government.

What You'll Do

In partnership with the General Manager, Program Managers, Chief Engineers and Engineering teams, you will own the development and deployment of Anduril’s TRS technologies to meet the operational needs of the Department of War.
Drive the technical execution of development programs from concept through delivery. Ensure all engineering deliverables meet contractual requirements, milestones, and technical standards.
Serve as a bridge between Program Managers and engineering functional teams.
Develop strong, trusting relationships with Anduril’s DOW customers, ensuring we have tight feedback loops that enable us to shape solutions, rapidly iterate, and ultimately field solutions faster
