jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT M'RHEN

M'RHEN is a New York–and Taipei–based luxury womenswear brand focused on refined femininity, emotional resonance, and intentional craftsmanship. Produced in New York City, the brand is known for its elevated tailoring, feminine silhouettes, and intimate approach to luxury.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a sharp, highly organized, and resourceful Executive & Business Operations Manager
to work directly alongside our Founder & Creative Director and serve as an operational right hand across M'RHEN.
This is a highly hands-on role at the center of a growing luxury fashion company. You will own key day-to-day business operations while providing the executive support that enables the founder and broader team to operate effectively. Your scope will span business and financial administration, executive operations, inventory and ecommerce, showroom and client experience, and special projects.
We are looking for someone who doesn't simply execute tasks, but creates structure, identifies what needs attention, follows through across multiple stakeholders, and takes ownership of getting things done.
Because M'RHEN is a small and growing company, there is no hierarchy of tasks. You should be equally comfortable preparing financial reports, coordinating with an accountant or production partner, managing a VIP client request, organizing the founder's international travel, or preparing the showroom ahead of an appointment.
For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to become a trusted operating partner to the founder while gaining firsthand exposure to the commercial, financial, creative, and operational decisions involved in building a luxury fashion house.

BUSINESS & FINANCIAL OPERATIONS

Maintain day-to-day financial visibility across the business, including expense tracking, receipt management, accounts payable and receivable, reconciliations, and cash-flow reporting.
Coordinate vendor payments, client invoicing, and payment follow-up.
Maintain organized financial records and liaise with the brand's external accountant on bookkeeping, tax preparation, reporting, and related financial administration.
Work with production and the founder to maintain visibility into production costs, margins, inventory value, and collection-level spending.
Prepare financial and operational information to support the founder's budgeting, cash-planning, and collection-planning decisions.
Coordinate payroll, insurance, business filings, and basic HR and compliance administration.
Build and maintain operational systems for expenses, inventory, reporting, documentation, and internal communication.
Identify operational gaps and proactively implement better processes as the company grows.

EXECUTIVE & FOUNDER OPERATIONS

Manage the founder's calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily priorities, anticipating needs and protecting the founder's time.
Coordinate domestic and international travel, itineraries, reservations, and transportation with precision.
Handle personal errands and administrative needs with discretion and follow-through.
Maintain organization across documents, contracts, receipts, records, and internal systems.
Liaise with factories, freelancers, PR teams, stylists, consultants, and external partners on behalf of the founder.
Track key follow-ups, deadlines, and outstanding decisions across the business, ensuring priorities move forward.
Prepare materials, information, and briefings needed for meetings and decision-making.
Support day-to-day operational needs and special priorities as they arise.

INVENTORY & ECOMMERCE OPERATIONS

Oversee accurate and timely fulfillment of ecommerce and client orders.
Maintain visibility into studio inventory, garment movements, and stock levels.
Maintain accurate inventory records and flag discrepancies or low-stock positions.
Coordinate sample trafficking, messenger pickups, shipments, returns, and inventory transfers.
Coordinate with studio and production partners to ensure garments and samples are where they need to be.
Support Shopify and other ecommerce operations and workflows as needed.

SHOWROOM & CLIENT EXPERIENCE

Manage and service showroom appointments with warmth, professionalism, discretion, and a strong eye for styling.
Serve as a first point of contact for VIP clients and custom-order inquiries, gathering details, communicating timelines, and escalating decisions to the founder when appropriate.
Communicate with clients via email and phone with exceptional care and precision.
Support gifting, hospitality, alterations, special orders, and order coordination to maintain an elevated client experience.
Maintain showroom presentation, including merchandising, steaming, organization, and restocking.
Support trunk shows, pop-ups, photoshoots, market appointments, and other brand events.

SPECIAL PROJECTS

As a close operating partner to the founder, the Executive & Business Operations Manager will support projects that fall outside a traditional job description. These may include research, vendor sourcing, events, new operational systems, market preparation, client initiatives, and other priorities that arise as the company grows.
The ability to take an ambiguous problem, determine what needs to happen, and drive it toward completion is essential.

QUALIFICATIONS

2–4 years of relevant professional experience; experience in fashion, luxury, retail, hospitality, or another highly detail-oriented environment strongly preferred.
Prior experience supporting a founder, entrepreneur, executive, or creative leader is a strong plus.
Strong operational instincts and demonstrated ability to create structure, maintain systems, and follow projects through to completion.
Comfortable working with numbers and financial information, with a working knowledge of bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, and basic financial reporting.
Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software is a plus.
Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
High level of discretion, judgment, and professionalism; comfortable handling sensitive business, financial, client, and personal information.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong client-facing presence and comfort interacting with high-end clientele and senior external partners.
A critical eye for garments, presentation, fit, and styling.
Proactive, resourceful, and calm under pressure, with the instinct to identify what needs to happen rather than waiting to be assigned every task.
Comfortable moving fluidly between high-level and hands-on responsibilities.
Familiarity with Shopify, Google Workspace, Notion, Airtable, or similar platforms is a plus.
Based in New York City with flexibility for occasional evenings and weekends during events, shoots, and market periods.

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE

You may be a particularly strong fit if you naturally notice what is missing, create a system for it, and follow through without needing repeated direction.
You are interested not only in fashion, but in how a fashion business actually works
. You want exposure to the decisions behind product, clients, operations, finance, production, PR, and growth—and you are willing to do the detailed work required to understand them.
You are comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can shift quickly and no two days look exactly the same. You enjoy being close to the action, operating with a high level of trust, and becoming increasingly valuable as you develop a deeper understanding of the founder and the business.

EXECUTIVE & FOUNDER OPERATIONS

Please send a brief introduction and your resume to info@m-rhen.com
with the subject line “Executive & Business Operations Manager — M'RHEN.”

In your introduction, please tell us briefly why you are interested in working inside an emerging luxury fashion company and share one example of a time you took ownership of a problem without being told exactly how to solve it.
We review applications on a rolling basis and will be in touch with candidates whose experience aligns closely with the role.

jobs.description:
Join our Insights and Analytics team at Helen of Troy and make an immediate impact on our trusted brands: OXO, Hydro Flask, Osprey, Honeywell, PUR, Braun, Vicks, Hot Tools, Drybar, Curlsmith, Revlon, and Olive & June. Together, we build innovative and useful products that elevate people's lives everywhere, every day.

Look around your home, and you'll find us everywhere,
in your kitchen, living room, bedroom, and bathroom. We are already making your everyday lives better. We are powered by knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and forward-thinking people committed to developing a culture of inclusion. Whether you are just starting your career or in need of a challenge, we recognize, develop, and empower talent!

Position:
Media Operations Analyst

Department:
Analytics for all brands

Work Location:
Morristown, NJ Hybrid (work 3 days onsite)

Hybrid Schedule:
At Helen of Troy, we embrace a flexible hybrid work model designed to support collaboration and productivity. For roles eligible for hybrid work, our standard schedule includes in-office collaboration from Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Any updates to this model will be communicated in advance. Please note that hybrid eligibility and schedules may vary based on business needs and manager expectations.

What You Will Be Doing

The Analyst, Media Operations role will sit on the Insights and Analytics team. This position will support the development, governance, and quality assurance of media data operations across Helen of Troy’s portfolio. This role will help ensure that paid media tracking, taxonomy, tagging, and reporting inputs are accurate, consistent, and usable downstream.

Media Operations sit at the intersection of media, analytics, agency operations, and DTC/IT data enablement. The Media Ops Analyst will partner closely with internal Analytics, Media, DTC, Brand, Demand Planning, IT, and agency teams to enforce standards, identify data quality gaps, and reduce downstream rework caused by inconsistent tracking or fragmented operational ownership.

Support day-to-day media operations governance across paid media campaigns, ensuring campaign setup, naming conventions, UTM parameters, taxonomy, and tracking requirements are consistently applied across channels, platforms, brands, and agency partners.
Monitor campaign data feeds and dashboard inputs to identify missing, misclassified, or inconsistent data across platforms such as Adobe, GA4, and other relevant environments.
Own recurring QA processes to validate that media tracking and tagging are sit on the functioning end-to-end, from campaign launch through reporting ingestion, dashboarding, and analytics use cases.
Support end-to-end site tracking and PLP implementation.
Support cross-functional alignment on media performance inputs, including flowcharts, campaign change logs, KPI benchmarks, site analytics, and other data sources used to connect media investment to business results.
Maintain and enforce media taxonomy standards, UTM governance, campaign naming conventions, and related documentation to support scalable and consistent performance reporting.
Support the implementation of data quality controls, issue logs, and escalation processes to reduce manual workarounds, reporting ambiguity, and recurring data cleanup.

Skills Needed To Be Successful In This Role

Experience with Adobe Analytics or other site analytics or e-commerce tool.
Understanding of e-commerce, paid media operations, campaign trafficking, tracking implementation, taxonomy, UTM structure, and reporting workflows.
Comfort working with digital media platforms, web analytics, dashboarding tools, and campaign data sets.
Strong project management and documentation skills, with the ability to build repeatable processes, governance standards, and operational playbooks.
Detail oriented and analytical mindset.

Minimum Qualifications

jobs.description:
Description

Are you passionate about orchestrating complex, cross-functional initiatives that transform how Amazon operates globally? The Amazon University Talent Acquisition (AUTA) team is seeking a Program Manager III to orchestrate tech initiatives, uniting process, program, and technology needs across Amazon's global talent acquisition ecosystem.

In this unique role you'll serve as the strategic bridge between AUTA's business needs and technical solution delivery, ensuring that technology enables our ideal state processes and programs rather than constraining them. Your focus will be on defining and delivering business requirements to our tech teams, ensuring technical teams deliver a solution that meets our business customers', stakeholders', and internal teams' needs and high standards.

Key job responsibilities

Refine (or redefine) and champion the ideal-state vision for AUTA offers and pre-boarding, working across technical, program, and recruiting teams to align on a shared direction that serves business customers, candidates, and recruiters
Lead end-to-end program management of complex cross-functional initiatives with considerable impact, establishing clear success criteria, employing workback plans and mechanisms to keep this project on track, and driving resolution of blockers across multiple stakeholder groups
Communicate clear prioritization of AUTA's most pressing problems/needs and ensuring tech teams design solutions meet diverse user persona needs
Create and maintain comprehensive project information, driving crisp decisions and clear communication of progress, timelines, and escalations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
Define, monitor, and analyze key performance metrics to identify optimization opportunities, proactively mitigate risks before they become roadblocks, and ensure solutions improve operational efficiency across the global recruitment lifecycle

A day in the life

You'll partner closely with AUTA teams and customers to understand their unique use cases and challenges, then collaborate with technical teams to ensure solutions align with operational and business needs. Your day involves maintaining a deep knowledge of AUTA's current and ideal-state operating model for demand, making sure that AUTA delivers quality and on-time information to technical teams, partnering with tech on a comprehensive workback schedules, driving intake and prioritization discussions across competing initiatives, analyzing performance metrics to identify opportunities, and coordinating launch readiness and change management planning to support successful rollouts across multiple teams and personas.

About The Team

AURA works within AUTA, Amazon's central campus hiring organization who support recruiting efforts across all streams, most countries, and over 150 roles. The team partners with AUTA to define ideal state processes and programs, then collaborates with technical teams to ensure solutions meet those needs effectively.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
Knowledge of general AI tools
Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.description:
Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced Program Manager (PM) to support a high-visibility Intelligence Community customer within a challenging, dynamic, and mission-focused environment in the Virginia and Maryland area. The successful candidate will serve as a PM responsible for a Cost-Plus Award Fee contract, completion/deliverables based. This position requires extensive previous experience as a Program Manager experience in the Intelligence Community.

The PM will collaborate with government stakeholders, program leadership, financial professionals, and cross-functional teams to support mission success.

Primary Responsibilities

Leadership & Program Management

Responsible for management of all contract activities that impact Leidos’ ability to meet the Government’s requirements.
Allocate and manage program resources, including staffing, facilities, budgets, recruitment and training (direct and indirect) on the contract.
Review and approve Estimate to Complete, Contract Data Requirements (CDR) and other financial reports based on contractual requirements.
Review risk and risk mitigation activities and report status to the Contracting Officer’s Technical Representative (COTR).
Prepare program status reviews and other formal reviews to be presented to the Government COTR. Communicate issues and solutions to the Government COTR.
Ensure compliance with all regulatory and administrative requirements imposed by the contract in coordination with the Contractor’s contracts staff.
Review all financial and technical reports before release to the Government.
Ensure cross-discipline integration within the contract to meet Government needs.
Oversee financial performance, Basis of Estimates (BOEs), Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs), Estimates to Complete (ETC), funds and labor reporting, and review/approval of all required financial deliverables.
Present Program Management Reviews (PMRs) to the customer.

Basic Qualifications

Active TS/SCI with Polygraph required.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related subject. Minimum of 10 years of experience working within or directly supporting the Intelligence Community.

Demonstrated experience supporting the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI/DNI).
Demonstrated experience in conducting requirements analysis, resource allocation, project costing, deliverable tracking, schedule and financial data monitoring, and reporting.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to senior government and contractor leadership.
Proven ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with customers, subcontractors, and cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
Position Description

CGI Federal is currently seeking an experienced Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Analyst to support a large Department of Homeland Security program.

This role will primarily focus on front end RPA/automation analysis, including conducting discovery sessions with DHS customers, mapping processes, identifying automation candidates, assessing feasibility, and translating operational challenges into clear requirements. The role partners with an existing RPA developer who handles build and deployment.

You will help determine whether something should be automated — not necessarily build the automation yourself.

This position is located in one of CGI Federal's offices in Fairfax, VA, Lebanon, VA, Lafayette, LA or Knoxville, TN; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable. You will be required to work in a CGI Federal office two days per week.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Conduct discovery sessions with DHS stakeholders to understand processes, pain points, and opportunities
Perform automation assessments including feasibility, complexity scoring, and value analysis
Document current state and future state workflows
Translate operational needs into clear, concise requirements
Work with the RPA developer to hand off validated, well defined automation candidates
Identify creative, innovative solutions to improve efficiency and reduce manual workloads
Support light testing and validation of automated solutions
Partner with business and technical teams to ensure accurate understanding of requirements

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Due to government contract and clearance requirements, U.S. citizenship and successful completion of a CGI background check are required.
3–5 years in business analysis, process analysis, or workflow optimization
Experience conducting discovery sessions and eliciting requirements from non technical stakeholders
Familiarity with RPA concepts (not necessarily deep development experience)
Experience evaluating processes for automation potential
Strong communication skills and comfort leading discussions with federal stakeholders
Ability to travel to client sites as needed.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Georgetown University comprises two unique campuses in the nation’s capital. With the Hilltop Campus located in the heart of the historic Georgetown neighborhood, and the Capitol Campus, just minutes from the U.S. Capitol and U.S. Supreme Court, Georgetown University offers rigorous academic programs, a global perspective, and unparalleled opportunities to engage with Washington, D.C. Our community is a close-knit group of remarkable individuals driven by intellectual inquiry, a commitment to social justice, and a shared dedication to making a difference in the world.

Requirements

Job Overview

The Office of Human Subject Protections (OHSP) is responsible for the review of all research activities that involve human subjects in accordance with federal regulations. The OHSP operations analyst will work under the direction of the Senior Director of the OHSP to manage the administrative functions necessary for the successful operations of the office. These functions include being the first point of contact for the OHSP offices, Email management, operational meeting agendas and minutes, administrative management of IRB membership, IRB account creation and trouble-shooting, paper and electronic file management, website development and management, carrying out financial functions (IRB charge back and tracking, expense approvals, supply ordering), coordination of the compilation of OHSP metrics for required reporting, general correspondence, create and publish public communication, and assist in managing office HR actions. Additionally assist in account management of HURON, CITI and others as needed.

Work Interactions

The Office of Human Subject Protections serves as the official oversight office for human subject research activities at Georgetown University. The Office of Human Subject Protections reports to the Medical Center Vice President (VP) for Research and the Vice Provost of Research for the Main Campus. The OHSP program coordinator reports directly to the Senior Director of the OHSP. They will serve to assist both the Office of Research Quality Assurance and the Institutional Review Board that fall under the OHSP. The position will interact with the research community as the first point of contact for the office and will assist in creating and publishing any public facing materials and communication. As such, this position requires someone with collaborative and concise verbal and written communication skills. The program coordinator will engage directly with the staff in OHSP on a daily basis to triage incoming communication. The individual in the position will be a critical member of the OHSP to ensure efficient operations.

Requirements And Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and 2-3 years of experience in operational management skills
Experience demonstrating highly effective communications skills and ability to work on multiple projects.
Computer proficiency is required, including MS Word, Excel, internet browsers, and email.
Basic financial management skills
Experience using video meeting and scheduling platforms.

Preferred Requirements And Qualifications

Masters in health care management, business or certificate in project management
Previous experience in administrative position
Website management
Familiarity with IRB/research software platforms

Working closely with regional pharmacy leadership, pharmacy trainers, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, IT, and Program Management, the incumbent ensures each launch is operationally ready, compliant with the regulatory and accreditation requirements of each province of operation, and sustainable once transitioned to steady state operations.

A Day in the Life (What you will do here):

Represent pharmacy operations on cross-functional implementation teams for new program launches nationally, from business award through go-live and transition to steady state.
Participate in program launch meetings, design workshops, and cross-functional working sessions with internal stakeholders and manufacturer partners as the standing pharmacy representative.
Advise on program design where pharmacy is impacted, providing input on operational feasibility, turnaround times, patient and prescriber experience, system and reporting implications, and downstream operational impacts before designs are finalized.
Translate program design documents, manufacturer requirements, and business rules into pharmacy operational requirements, workflows, and process maps.
Lead pharmacy readiness activities for new Patient Support Programs, product launches, and program expansions across the national pharmacy network, including gap assessments, implementation plans, timelines, and go-live checklists.
Act as the pharmacy subject matter expert to Patient Support Programs, Provider Solutions, Clinic Services, Quality & PV, and IT on pharmacy capabilities, feasibility, and operational constraints.
Coordinate implementation activities with regional pharmacy leadership and site managers in all regions to ensure launches are executed consistently across the national network.
Partner with pharmacy trainers to develop and document national standard operating procedures and work instructions for new and changing programs, and move them through the document control, review, and approval process.
Coordinate training and competency plans with pharmacy trainers so that pharmacy staff are trained prior to go-live.
Submit and manage change requests for new and revised pharmacy reports, including defining requirements, coordinating user acceptance testing, and obtaining sign-off.
Work with regional pharmacy leads to assess head count needs for new programs and volume changes at each site, supporting workload analysis, hiring plans, and supporting business cases.
Define pharmacy system requirements for new programs and coordinate configuration with IT, vendors, and pharmacy management.
Identify, document, and escalate implementation risks, issues, and dependencies, and track them through to resolution.
Ensure implemented processes align with applicable regulatory, accreditation, privacy, and professional practice requirements in every province of operation, escalating questions to Legal, Quality, and Privacy as appropriate.
Maintain implementation documentation, including requirement traceability, decision logs, launch records, and post-implementation lessons learned.
Lead post-launch stabilization reviews and formal handover to pharmacy operations, confirming that procedures, reporting, and performance metrics are in place.
Represent pharmacy at client/manufacturer implementation meetings
Monitor performance metrics for newly launched programs and recommend continuous improvement actions to pharmacy leadership.
Standardize and share implementation practices across the national pharmacy network to sustain consistent national standards and processes while accommodating provincial differences.
Act as subject matter expert and provide project support on additional special projects as assigned, including system upgrades, new site openings, and standardization initiatives.
Additional duties as determined by your Manager

What you need to ensure you are set up for success:

Minimum 5 years of pharmacy operations experience

jobs.title: Project Manager - Data and Analytics
jobs.description:
DEPARTMENT:
BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE / DATA

ABOUT XTENDOPS

XO delivers outsourced customer experience and business operations, built on operational excellence, AI-driven innovation, and a bold approach to problem-solving. We help companies run smarter, operate more efficiently, and drive measurable business impact.

We are in the middle of a massive evolution, expanding beyond traditional outsourcing into a next-generation model that integrates AI, automation, and SaaS-driven solutions to deliver outcome-focused business services. Our vision is not just to improve CX. It is to reinvent how businesses leverage technology, data, and human expertise to create intelligent, scalable, and revenue-generating service models.

MAIN JOB OBJECTIVE:

The Project Manager — Data & Analytics runs the team's two scaling efforts, expanding data modeling and reporting delivery across a growing number of client accounts, and building the delivery path that pushes modeled data into the internal software platform, as structured, sprint-driven programs rather than a stream of ad-hoc requests. Day-to-day execution runs on Scrum, layered with phase-gated milestone planning for multi-quarter platform initiatives and client-facing commitments.

This is a hands-on delivery role. It does not involve writing production data models or application code, but does require reading a pipeline dependency graph, understanding what a data model is, and holding a technical conversation with an engineer without a translator.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND MAIN ACTIVITIES

Agile / Scrum Delivery:

Own the Scrum cadence end to end for a team spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, software development, and analytics: sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Act as Scrum Master in practice, protecting the sprint from mid-sprint scope injection, removing impediments, and coaching the team on Agile discipline where habits are still ad-hoc.
Maintain a healthy, groomed, estimated backlog with clear definition-of-ready and definition-of-done, sizing and slicing stories so they can finish inside a sprint.
Track and use delivery metrics, including velocity, sprint burndown, cycle time, carryover, and escaped defects, to forecast credibly and drive retrospective actions that change how the team works.
Run the hybrid layer, mapping sprint output onto phase-gated milestones for platform initiatives and client commitments so short-cycle iteration and long-horizon dates stay reconciled.
Adapt the process to the work: Scrum for product and modeling delivery, Kanban-style flow for operational and support requests, and phase gates for migrations and client cutovers.
Continuously improve the operating model and raise team maturity in estimation, story writing, and predictable delivery.

Roadmap and Program Ownership:

Own the consolidated delivery roadmap covering platform initiatives and client reporting work, keeping it current, sequenced, and visible to stakeholders.
Drive multi-phase rollouts from pilot through full deployment, tracking scope, dependencies, and clear exit criteria for each phase.
Break large initiatives into deliverable increments with named owners, acceptance criteria, and dates, and identify the critical path and the dependencies that will break it.
Keep the team's architectural decision record current so decisions are written down, discoverable, and not relitigated.

Intake and Prioritization:

Run a single intake process for all data, dashboard, and reporting requests coming from operations leaders, account teams, and the product side.
Triage and prioritize against business impact, effort, and available capacity, saying no or not-yet credibly with reasoning stakeholders can accept.
Protect engineering focus by batching requests, eliminating duplicates, and preventing direct-to-engineer side channels from becoming the default.

Cross-Team Delivery and Hand-offs:

Coordinate hand-offs along the full data path, including ingestion, modeling, publishing, and application delivery, where each stage has a different owner and skill set.
Track and unblock work: surface risks early, escalate with a recommendation rather than just a problem, and keep blocked work from sitting silently.
Coordinate release and migration work with product and engineering counterparts, including cutover plans and rollback paths.

Stakeholder Management:

Act as the primary point of contact between the data team and operations leadership, account teams, and product stakeholders.
Translate in both directions: business requirements into technical scope engineers can act on, and technical constraints into trade-offs business stakeholders can decide on.
Run regular program reviews and status reporting, keeping leadership informed with honest, concise updates rather than dashboards nobody reads.
Support client-facing commitments around data scope, freshness expectations, and what the team will and will not promise.

SLAs, Cost, and Quality:

Define and track delivery and data SLAs, including pipeline freshness, refresh cadence, incident response, and request turnaround.
Monitor and report cloud spend across the data and application stack, ensuring budgets, usage alerts, and quotas are in place and acted upon.
Treat data freshness as a deliberate decision per report rather than a default, since refresh frequency is a primary cost driver in cloud data platforms.
Partner with engineering on test coverage, freshness and anomaly monitoring, and incident post-mortems, making sure findings turn into backlog items.

Team Scaling:

Support a phased hiring plan as the team grows, including role scoping, interview coordination, and onboarding plans.
Track team capacity and utilization against account load, flagging early when delivery commitments exceed available capacity.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

3–5 years of project, program, or delivery management experience on technical teams (data, analytics, platform, or software engineering), with at least part of that time managing engineers directly as a PM rather than only coordinating vendors or business projects.
Substantial hands-on Scrum experience required: personally running the full ceremony set across many consecutive sprints, owning a backlog, facilitating retrospectives, and using velocity and burndown data to forecast. Scrum Master or equivalent time-in-seat strongly preferred.
Proven hybrid-methodology delivery, combining Agile execution with phase-gated or milestone-based planning on the same program, and able to explain concretely how the two were kept honest with each other.
Working knowledge of more than one Agile framework and the judgment to pick per workstream: Scrum for product delivery, Kanban or Scrumban for support and operational request flow, phase gates for migrations.
Demonstrated ownership of a multi-phase technical program from planning through delivery, including managing dependencies across more than one team.
Working data literacy: able to explain what a data warehouse, a pipeline, an ETL/ELT job, and a data model are; able to read a pipeline dependency graph and understand what depends on what; comfortable with basic SQL.
Fluency configuring and running Agile boards, sprints, and reporting in a work-management tool such as ClickUp, Jira, Azure DevOps, Asana, or Linear.
Strong stakeholder management: able to hold a line on priorities with a senior stakeholder, and deliver bad news early and clearly.
Excellent written communication in English, since much of this role is writing status updates, requirements, decision records, and escalations.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and incomplete information, and the judgment to know when to decide versus when to escalate.

PREFERRED

Scrum certification (CSM, PSM I/II, or PSPO) is a strong plus, as is PMI-ACP, PMP, or SAFe for the hybrid and phase-gated side. Track record outweighs certification, but the vocabulary and rigor behind it are expected.
Experience introducing or maturing Agile practice on a team that was previously running ad-hoc.
Experience applying Agile to data work specifically, where "done" is a tested data model or pipeline rather than a shipped interface feature.
Experience in a BPO, outsourcing, or shared-services environment, or otherwise managing delivery across multiple client accounts simultaneously.
Familiarity with a modern data stack: a cloud warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks; transformation tooling such as dbt; and workflow orchestration such as Airflow.
Exposure to cloud cost management or FinOps: budgets, spend attribution, usage monitoring.
Enough understanding of web application delivery (APIs, caching, deployment) to coordinate a data-to-application delivery path.
Familiarity with data governance topics relevant to client-facing analytics: tenant isolation, role-based access control, and PII handling.
Experience coordinating BI and reporting delivery with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Prior involvement in scaling a team: hiring loops, onboarding, capacity planning.

﻿
AVAILABILITY

Full-time, remote, with overlap required across North America and Asia-Pacific business hours.

SKILLS

Scrum Facilitation and Agile Coaching
Hybrid (Agile + Phase-Gated) Program Management
Backlog Management and Estimation
Delivery Metrics and Forecasting (Velocity, Burndown, Cycle Time)
Intake and Prioritization
Cross-Team Coordination and Dependency Management
Stakeholder Management and Executive Communication
SLA and Cost Tracking
Working Data Literacy (Pipelines, Warehousing, SQL)
Documentation and Decision Records
Team Capacity Planning

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Outform Group, our guiding philosophy is Dare To Innovate.

Outform Group specializes in creating tangible consumer engagements that elevate, connect and humanize brand experiences. We unite leading experts in research, strategy, design, innovation and manufacturing, who work together to create unforgettable brand experiences.

Lean, interdisciplinary teams work in close collaboration with clients, helping them to solve their user’s biggest problems. Our user-centric, data-driven approach focuses on creating a seamless experience across different environments.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager
to own and drive complex, high‑visibility technology initiatives from concept through global deployment.

This role requires a seasoned technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, navigates complexity with ease, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to deeply understand technologies that power modern retail experiences. Curiosity, technical breadth, and strong execution discipline are essential.

DIRECT REPORTS

None

SCOPE & ACCOUNTABILITY

This role owns the full lifecycle of complex, high-visibility technology programs—from initial scoping and architecture through global deployment and long-term support. The Senior Technical Project Manager serves as the central technical authority and primary client-facing leader for large-scale retail technology initiatives, with initial focus on multi-phase LED video wall programs for a major retail brand. This position carries direct accountability for program outcomes across scope, timeline, budget, and quality, while simultaneously building and maintaining high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones. The role operates with significant autonomy and is expected to make high-impact decisions that shape both client experience and internal capability.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Oversight

Provide senior-level oversight across multiple concurrent technology programs, ensuring technical feasibility, design excellence, and flawless execution within scope, timeline, and budget.
Evaluate project opportunities, define high-level architecture, determine resource needs, and guide teams through complex decision-making.
Lead the development and integration of hardware, software, and physical display systems, ensuring seamless performance in demanding retail environments.
Build and maintain high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones.
Define technical requirements, develop comprehensive technology BOMs, and guide sourcing, procurement, and estimation strategies.

Program & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, translating their goals into actionable technical plans and delivering executive-level communication.
Oversee large-scale project roadmaps, risk mitigation strategies, and milestone tracking across multiple parallel workstreams.
Maintain and evolve technical documentation, including wiring schematics, integration maps, digital die lines, and BOMs.
Define and implement documentation standards, QA processes, and best practices for installation, support, and troubleshooting.
Lead internal and external status meetings, delivering clear updates to senior stakeholders.

Hands-On Technical Execution

Personally evaluate, test, and validate technology solutions as part of pre-sale exploration, prototyping, and client demonstrations.
Build quick-turn prototypes and technology demos that support new business development and innovation initiatives.
Act as a tier-two escalation point for complex troubleshooting, ensuring issues are resolved swiftly and root causes are understood.
Partner with technology vendors to scope, assess, and co-develop solutions tailored for retail activation.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

Operate as the central hub between engineering, design, production, sourcing, and client teams—translating technical details into clear, actionable insights.
Foster an inclusive and collaborative environment that encourages experimentation, knowledge sharing, and creative problem-solving.
Anticipate communication gaps and proactively bridge them across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to scaling technical project management capabilities across the organization.

KEY INTERFACES (NON-REPORTING)

This role collaborates consistently with the following teams and functions outside its direct reporting structure: Engineering and Software Development teams (hardware/software integration), Design and Creative teams (retail experience and display design), Production and Fabrication teams (manufacturing and physical build), Sourcing and Procurement teams (vendor and component management), Client stakeholders and executive sponsors, Technology Vendors and LED/digital signage suppliers, Global Manufacturing Partners (including production facilities in China), and Installation and Field Support teams.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Success in this role will be measured against metrics including but not limited to:

On-time and on-budget delivery rate across assigned technology programs
Client satisfaction scores and retention on managed accounts
Prototype and demo quality as measured by client approval and conversion
Speed and effectiveness of issue resolution (escalation response time)
Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation (BOMs, schematics, integration maps)
Cross-functional team feedback on communication clarity and collaboration
Adherence to QA standards and reduction in post-installation defects

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field preferred; equivalent work experience accepted. Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in a technical project management role within experiential, retail, hardware, software, or systems integration environments.

Technical Knowledge

Strong foundation in both hardware and software systems with ability to engage in deep technical discussions
Prior experience with LED systems, digital signage, and retail technology highly preferred
Familiarity with wiring schematics, integration maps, and technology BOMs
Hands-on technical aptitude (e.g., PC building, coding, home networking, video editing, or interactive technology tinkering)

Program Management Skills

Proven track record managing large, multi-stakeholder programs with competing priorities
Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation, QA processes, and installation standards
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

Communication & Leadership

Exceptional communication and leadership presence with demonstrated client-facing skills
Ability to translate complex technical information for non-technical audiences
Experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders

Other Requirements

Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time (domestic and international, including China)
Availability for weekly calls with teams in China across time zones

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES & PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

Strategic & Innovative Thinker: Approaches problems with a forward-thinking mindset, comfortable owning high-impact decisions and operating with autonomy in ambiguous situations.

Exceptional Communicator: Able to simplify technical complexity for any audience—from engineers to C-suite executives—with clarity, confidence, and precision.

Trust Builder: Earns credibility through deep preparation, technical intelligence, and consistent execution. Develops high-trust relationships with clients, vendors, and internal teams alike.

Relentless Problem Solver: Thrives under pressure with a track record of delivering results. Approaches obstacles with a solutions-oriented mindset and never leaves an issue unresolved.

Collaborative Influencer: Skilled at guiding cross-functional decisions and rallying diverse teams behind a shared goal without formal authority.

Passionate About Retail Technology: Genuinely energized by leveraging technology to create best-in-class customer experiences in physical retail environments.

Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented: Consistently meets deadlines, maintains rigorous documentation standards, and keeps complex programs on track simultaneously.

Self-Driven & Proactive: Takes initiative without being prompted, anticipates needs before they arise, and is energized by building what doesn’t yet exist.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Operations Analyst

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Operations Analyst to join the Operations team at Zima Dental. This is a high-responsibility role for someone who has already built a foundation in operations and wants real ownership and broad exposure to how a fast-growing, high-volume physical product business actually runs day to day.

The role sits within Operations and spans the full breadth of what that means at Zima: supply chain (production, freight and logistics, warehousing and fulfilment, forecasting and planning), as well as quality and regulatory support, customer experience operations, and cross-functional projects with Product, Commercial, and Growth. Core supply chain operations will be a significant focus of the day-to-day work, but the role is not limited to it, you'll get exposure across the operational engine of the business rather than sitting in one lane.

This is not a role limited to executing a narrow, well-defined supply chain function. We're looking for someone who has previously helped build, shape, or support an operations department, not just operated within one. You'll be expected to contribute immediately, solve problems independently, and take ownership early. You'll work closely with senior leadership and gain exposure to how decisions are made across every part of the business. The expectation is not just that you support projects, but that you actively help drive them forward.

This is a fast-paced environment with high standards and high expectations. In return, high performers are given rapid progression, significant ownership, and the opportunity to grow into leadership roles quickly.

If you want responsibility early, genuine breadth across how a business operates, plenty of analytical challenges to dig into, and the opportunity to accelerate your career far faster than in a traditional corporate environment, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Supply Chain

Work across the end-to-end supply chain, from production through to final delivery, without owning any one stage outright.
Work directly with suppliers on production and order coordination, helping ensure orders are placed, tracked, and delivered on time and to spec.
Oversee freight management rather than managing it directly, making sure processes run efficiently and freight is coordinated in a timely manner in line with stock requirements.
Track and monitor the performance of key 3PL accounts to keep fulfilment operations running efficiently.

Forecasting, Planning & Inventory

Support demand forecasting and replenishment planning across products and markets.
Help maintain healthy inventory levels, balancing availability against working capital and avoiding both stockouts and overstock.
Contribute to launch and sale-event planning so the chain is ready for demand spikes.

Data & Business Analysis

Build reporting and track performance against key operational metrics across supply chain and other functions.
Build models and run scenario analysis to pressure-test plans and support better decisions.
Turn messy operational data into clear insight that drives action.

ERP Process Improvement & Scaling

Work within Zima Dental's ERP, ensuring data and records are accurate, well maintained, and run smoothly across the team.
Go beyond day-to-day upkeep to develop SOPs that improve consistency and execution quality across the platform.
Use the ERP, alongside reporting tools and AI, to build new reporting capabilities that give the business better visibility over operational performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Quality teams to support business-critical initiatives.
Coordinate across internal teams and external partners (suppliers, freight forwarders, 3PLs) to keep product moving.

Ownership & Growth

Take increasing ownership of operational verticals and projects as you develop in the role.
Operate with a problem-solving mindset and strong attention to detail.
Contribute ideas proactively and take initiative rather than waiting for direction.
Develop a broad understanding of how a high-growth, high-volume physical product business scales operationally, across every function it touches.

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

1-3 years of experience in an operations role.
Degree in Science, Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field preferred.
Startup or fast-scaling company experience is a strong plus, given the pace of this role.
Experience working within an ERP system, ideally having gone beyond basic use to help improve processes, reporting, or data quality within one.

Skills

Strong analytical and quantitative ability, and genuine enjoyment of solving complex, data-heavy problems.
Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
Commercially aware, with the ability to think beyond individual tasks and understand cost and service trade-offs.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work across teams and with external partners.
Ability to prioritise effectively in a fast-moving, high-volume environment.

Mindset

Highly ambitious and motivated by responsibility.
Ownership-driven with a bias toward action.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.
Genuinely analytically minded, and energised by digging into data and tackling analytical challenges.
Excited by solving difficult problems and learning quickly.
Resilient, adaptable, and execution-focused.
Wants to grow quickly into a future leadership role.

Why Join Us

Zima Dental is a fast-growing premium consumer brand operating globally and scaling quickly. We move high volumes of physical product across multiple markets, which makes supply chain central to how we grow. We give talented people responsibility early and expect them to perform at a high level.

In this role, you'll gain genuine breadth and depth across the entire supply chain, from production and freight through to warehousing, fulfilment, and planning. You'll work on projects that genuinely matter, collaborate closely with senior leadership, and build a strong foundation across every stage of how the product reaches the customer.

Benefits

28 days holiday (excluding bank holidays).
Company pension.
Cycle to Work scheme.
Ongoing learning and development support.
Weekly team and company social activities.
Direct collaboration with senior leadership.
Fast career progression opportunities and significant ownership from an early stage.

3+ years of experience in accounting & payroll operations, preferably within an independent school or non-profit environment.

Understanding of tuition billing cycles, payroll processing, month-end closing, and non-profit/fund accounting practices. 
Strong skills in Microsoft office Excel / Google Drive
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with empathy and clarity when communicating to parents, church members, and staff; ability to take direction, multitask, and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
Work both independently and collaboratively, maintain strict confidentiality, and enthusiastically support the organizations’ missions, values, and visions.

jobs.title: UGC Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Chief Detective:

Chief Detective is a performance marketing agency helping fast-growing startups and established retail brands scale revenue and acquisition through paid digital channels. Recognized as a top agency on Meta, we’re expanding rapidly across platforms including TikTok, Google, and CTV.

We specialize in e-commerce and partner with leading direct-to-consumer brands in luxury apparel, beauty, health & wellness and lifestyle. Our clients include Rag & Bone, Ursa Major, Buck Mason, Frank & Eileen, TWP and more.

About the Role:

The UGC Program Manager owns the successful execution and continuous improvement of Chief Detective's User-Generated Content (UGC) program. Serving as the operational hub between clients, Growth Partners, Creative Strategists, creators, and internal production teams, this role is responsible for delivering high-quality creator content on time, on budget, and with exceptional communication throughout every stage of the process.

Success in this role extends beyond campaign coordination. The UGC Program Manager is expected to build and maintain a reliable creator network, proactively solve operational challenges, improve internal processes, and create a best-in-class experience for both clients and creators.
This role is ultimately accountable for ensuring our UGC program operates with consistency, transparency, urgency, and professionalism while continually evolving into a scalable, repeatable service offering.

What You’ll Do:

Creator Recruitment & Relationship Management

Own the sourcing, onboarding, and management of a diverse network of high-quality UGC creators capable of supporting client objectives across multiple industries.

Responsibilities include:
Source and recruit creators aligned with client demographics and creative needs
Build and maintain an active creator database
Vet creators for quality, communication, reliability, and turnaround speed
Negotiate compensation and usage rights
Manage creator relationships throughout campaign lifecycles
Build a preferred roster of trusted creators for repeat engagement
Continually expand and diversify the creator network

UGC Campaign Management

Manage multiple simultaneous UGC programs from kickoff through final asset delivery. The UGC Program Manager should confidently manage approximately 5–8 active client programs
simultaneously while maintaining exceptional organization and communication.

Responsibilities include:
Coordinate creator outreach and selection
Manage product shipments and creator logistics
Distribute briefs and campaign requirements
Execute creator contracts through DocuSign
Track campaign milestones and deadlines
Collect, organize, and deliver creator assets
Coordinate revisions when necessary
Ensure campaigns remain on schedule

Client & Internal Communication

Serve as the operational point person for UGC campaign execution by maintaining proactive communication across internal teams and client stakeholders. No stakeholder should ever be surprised by the status of an active UGC campaign.

Responsibilities include:
Provide timely campaign updates to Growth Partners and Senior Creative Strategists
Communicate campaign progress and risks to clients in coordination with account stakeholders
Escalate issues before they impact timelines
Recommend operational solutions whenever challenges arise
Ensure all stakeholders remain informed throughout campaign execution
Maintain a high standard of professionalism and responsiveness

Program Operations

Maintain the systems, documentation, and workflows that keep the UGC program operating efficiently.
Responsibilities include:
Maintain project tracking within ClickUp
Organize creator documentation within Google Drive
Develop and maintain Google Docs, Sheets, and briefing templates
Execute creator agreements using DocuSign
Track creator performance and historical engagement
Ensure accurate documentation across every project
Monitor deadlines and proactively resolve bottlenecks

Program Development & Continuous Improvement

Help evolve Chief Detective's UGC offering through ongoing operational improvements.

Responsibilities include:
Improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
Develop reusable documentation and templates
Build creator playbooks and onboarding materials
Document campaign learnings
Produce internal case studies highlighting successful creator partnerships
Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend improvements
Improve turnaround times while maintaining quality standards
Contribute to the long-term scalability of the UGC program

Success Metrics

Success is measured not only by campaign completion, but by the confidence and trust built across clients, creators, and internal teams.

Key performance indicators include:
Operational Excellence

Successfully manage 5–8 concurrent client programs
Deliver campaigns on agreed timelines
Maintain organized documentation across all projects
Meet internal response-time expectations
Minimize missed deadlines

Communication

Proactively communicate campaign progress
Escalate risks before they become client issues
Keep Growth Partners and Creative Strategists consistently informed
Maintain timely responses across Slack and email
Close communication loops without prompting

Creator Network

Grow and strengthen the creator database
Maintain relationships with top-performing creators
Improve creator turnaround time
Reduce creator attrition
Identify new creator sourcing opportunities

Program Development

Continuously improve workflows
Maintain current SOP documentation
Develop case studies from successful campaigns
Recommend process improvements
Increase operational efficiency over time

What We’re Looking For:

3+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, production coordination, project management, or campaign operations
Exceptional organizational and project management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects
Strong negotiation and relationship management abilities
Ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced agency environment
High attention to detail and follow-through
Technical proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail), ClickUp, Slack, DocuSign
Familiarity with creator management platforms is a plus

Why Join Chief Detective:

Be at the forefront of digital marketing
Competitive salary and benefits package
Partner with recognized fast-growing DTC and e-commerce brands
Be part of a team that blends analytical rigor with creative experimentation
Work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your insights directly drive performance
Remote-first flexibility with a culture that values curiosity, growth, and attention to detail

Compensation & Benefits:

This position has an approved compensation range of $90,000 to $100,000

A comprehensive benefits package that includes group medical, dental, and vision coverage; short and long-term disability; life insurance; 401(k) eligibility after one year of service with matching contributions; paid time off; sick leave; and an Employee Assistance Program, and more.

jobs.description:
Brandtech+ (formerly known as OLIVER+) is a global team of creative thinkers, tech-savvy trendsetters, and production pros specialising in film, CGI, automation, AI, motion design, and digital/print content. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting . Our focus is to connect clients with high-quality solutions , talent and ambitious opportunities worldwide.   
As a part of The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.
Role: Senior Project Manager (Social)

Location: South Africa (Remote working until further notice)

Brandtech+ is a global team of creative thinkers, tech-savvy trendsetters, and production pros specialising in film, CGI, automation, AI, motion design, and digital/print content. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. 
Our focus is to connect clients with high-quality solutions,  talent and ambitious opportunities worldwide.   

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  

THE OPPORTUNITY   
Looking to do the best work of your career?   
As one of the most respected global brands on social, we’re building a team across 15 markets to own the client’s social presence end to end: insight and ideation, platform-native creative, publishing, live ops, and community. From the first idea to the final reply, you’ll shape how the brand shows up every day and create work that influences culture.   
You’ll move at newsroom speed with rigorous craft—launching ideas that travel, partnering with standout creators, and turning comments into conversations that become cultural moments. The brief is straightforward: make the brand the most culturally relevant brand on social. You’ll have the scale, purpose, and creative freedom to make it real.   
If you’re motivated by ideas that matter, sharpened by data, and committed to making the internet more positive, this is the place to do it. Bring your craft and your courage. Together we’ll build culture—not just content—and do the best work of our careers.   
You'll be the production backbone of the brand’s social content operation, orchestrating fast-turnaround campaigns, always-on content, and creator-led projects across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and emerging platforms. You'll keep complex, multi-stream social projects moving smoothly from brief to publish, partnering closely with creatives, content creators, social media managers, and the brand team. Your ability to bring order to speed, and rigour to agility, will ensure the studio consistently delivers high-quality social work on time and on budget.       
THE ROLE   
You'll be the person who makes social-first creative happen. Behind every piece of content that lands on social channels, there's planning, scheduling, coordination, and problem-solving, and that's where you come in. Working across always-on content, reactive cultural moments, creator collaborations, and campaign launches, you'll manage the full production lifecycle for social content at a pace that matches the platforms themselves.   
We're looking for someone who thrives in quick-turnaround environments, who understands social content production inside and out, and who can coordinate across creative teams, external creators, and client stakeholders without dropping a beat. Success means social work that ships on time, on brief, and on budget, with the studio running efficiently, the team supported, and the client confident in the process.   

WHAT YOU'LL DO   
Lead end-to-end project management for social-first content and campaigns, from brief intake through to delivery and publish   
Plan and manage fast-turnaround production workflows for short-form video, static, motion, and interactive social content   
Coordinate with content creators, influencer partners, and talent to ensure smooth production schedules, clear deliverables, and timely asset delivery   
Partner with social media managers to align content calendars, publishing schedules, and reactive opportunities with production capacity   
Manage day-to-day communication with the brand team, keeping stakeholders informed, approvals on track, and feedback loops tight   
Build and maintain project schedules, resource plans, and budgets across multiple concurrent workstreams   
Establish and refine production processes tailored to social speed, including templates, workflows, and toolkits that help the team move quickly without sacrificing quality   
Oversee quality control for all social deliverables, ensuring assets meet platform specs, brand guidelines, and compliance requirements   
Identify and mitigate risks proactively, managing scope, timeline, and budget with clarity and accountability   
Integrate Gen AI tools into production workflows where they add genuine value, improving efficiency, iteration speed, and content volume without compromising craft   
Track and report on project performance, production metrics, and budget utilisation, using data to drive continuous improvement   
Support and coordinate the creative team, removing blockers and fostering a collaborative, organised, and sustainable working environment   

WHAT YOU BRING   
5+ years of project management or production experience, with a strong focus on social content production for consumer brands

jobs.title: IT Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The IT Security Program Manager
is responsible for executing and managing the day-to-day operations of Recovery Centers of America’s cybersecurity program. Reporting to the manager of infrastructure under the IT OPS director and ensures that RCA’s security posture remains compliant with HIPAA
, HITECH
, and NIST 800-53
standards while continuously improving the effectiveness of the organization’s security controls and risk management framework.

This role will coordinate and perform audits, oversee third-party risk management, manage RCA’s security awareness and phishing programs, drive policy governance, and ensure the timely resolution of open risk items and vulnerabilities. The ideal candidate is an organized, hands-on leader with a strong understanding of healthcare security and compliance who can align security initiatives with RCA’s mission of saving one million lives.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Program Management & Governance

Manage the daily operations of RCA’s cybersecurity program under the guidance of the CISO.
Coordinate and track the completion of internal and external security audits, including HIPAA, SOC 2, and NIST-based assessments.
Maintain and monitor the Information Security Risk Register, ensuring timely resolution of identified issues and mitigation of critical findings.
Lead tabletop exercises and incident response simulations to test and improve RCA’s preparedness and business continuity planning.
Collaborate with RCA leadership and department heads to ensure that security policies and controls are understood and effectively implemented across all business units.

Third-Party Risk & Vendor Management

Manage the third-party risk assessment program, ensuring that all vendors with access to PHI or critical systems undergo security evaluation and periodic reassessment.
Review BAAs, security questionnaires, and compliance attestations; ensure corrective action for identified gaps.
Partner with Procurement and Legal to integrate security requirements into new and existing vendor contracts.

Policy, Compliance, and Reporting

Work with the CISO to review, update, and publish information security policies, standards, and procedures in accordance with HIPAA, HITECH, and NIST frameworks.
Develop dashboards and recurring reports to track security metrics, compliance posture, and program maturity for presentation to the CISO and executive leadership.
Monitor and interpret changes to regulatory requirements, ensuring timely updates to RCA’s compliance program.

Security Awareness & Training

Administer and optimize RCA’s KnowBe4 Security Awareness and Phishing Training Program.
Track user engagement and training completion rates, and provide metrics and recommendations to leadership.
Develop creative awareness campaigns to strengthen RCA’s security culture.

Vulnerability & Infrastructure Management

Identify and track critical infrastructure vulnerabilities, working with IT and Infrastructure teams to ensure remediation and continuous monitoring.
Oversee MDM security, ensuring appropriate device controls, encryption, and enforcement of mobile security policies.
Support the CISO in analyzing threat intelligence, vulnerability trends, and endpoint security performance (e.g., CrowdStrike, firewall alerts).

Risk and Compliance Leadership

Ensure continuous compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, and NIST 800-53 / 800-171 requirements.
Coordinate with Compliance, Legal, and Clinical leadership to ensure consistent risk management practices.
Participate in post-incident reviews, documenting lessons learned and recommending process improvements.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required.

Experience

Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, IT risk management, or audit within a regulated environment (preferably healthcare).
At least 2 years in a program management or leadership role overseeing information security functions.
Strong working knowledge of HIPAA, NIST 800-53, HITRUST, and security risk management frameworks.

Certifications (preferred But Not Required)

Security +, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, HCISPP, or equivalent security certification.
PMP or similar project management certification is a plus.

Technical Skills

Understanding of endpoint protection, SIEM tools, MDM platforms (e.g., Intune), and vulnerability management solutions.
Experience with vendor risk tools, audit tracking systems, and compliance reporting.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Security Suite, KnowBe4, and GRC platforms.

Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical risks for non-technical stakeholders.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional relationships and drive accountability.
Passionate about RCA’s mission and maintaining the privacy and security of patient information

Travel

Limited travel is required for this position
This position is primarily a remote position

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About the job

We’re passionate about designing and delivering top-notch digital experiences for our clients — and their customers — and helping them create efficiencies using data and technology. But what’s most important about us is that we have a diverse team of experts all dedicated to getting clients from goals to outcomes — and that’s where you come in.

*This is a hybrid position. Will need to work 3 days a week in offices located in Columbus, OH.

As a Senior Project Manager, you’ll be joining our team of talented experts. The right candidate will possess the following experience:

You will lead cross-functional teams to successfully deliver projects that span technical development, data integration, and user experience design. You’ll be responsible for end-to-end project ownership, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget while meeting our high standards of quality and client satisfaction. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to define project goals, manage risks, align resources, and foster collaboration between disciplines. Your strategic thinking, proactive communication, and ability to navigate ambiguity will make you a key leader on our delivery team.

Who you are:

Prior experience working within an agency environment, including managing multiple stakeholders, balancing competing priorities, and supporting fast-paced client delivery initiatives.
Consistently demonstrate the ability to lead the client through complex decision-making processes to help them understand future impacts and trade-off’s.
You see issues before they happen.
You shift seamlessly between in-the-weeds details to viewing the larger picture of the strategy.
A creative problem solver that can create consensus and comradery across the cross-functional and client teams.
An intent listener that captures nuances and client feedback in a way that is actionable for the team.
Empathetic yet pragmatic when processing team feedback, issues and concerns.
Viewed as a trusted leader within the team while also being a neutral party to ultimately do what’s best for the team, client and overall success of the project.
Curious about the work we are delivering, your client’s business and overall business landscape and regularly apply those learnings to key decisions throughout the project.
You build trust with teams and clients by consistently following through on your commitments.
You can “read the room” and have a high degree of emotional intelligence – knowing the right times to ask insightful questions or share an observation that will advance the conversation.
Highly productive – you know how to prioritize your time to the highest value activities to stay within the project budget and manage your workload.
You create a sense of calm and effortlessness.

Key Responsibilities

Lead project planning, prioritization, backlog management, and execution across multiple, concurrent workstreams involving technical, data, and UX deliverables.
Apply existing G2O process frameworks and contribute to the creation of new ones.
Manage client relationships, ensuring transparency, trust, and alignment on goals, scope, timelines, and outcomes.
Develop project charters, roadmaps, and timelines. Lead the development of project budgets, and resource plans in partnership with line of business leads.
Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies, adapting project methodologies as needed.
Identify and mitigate project risks, blockers, and dependencies.
Ensure accurate documentation and regular project reporting for internal stakeholders and clients.
Maintain project financials, including budget tracking, forecasting, and invoicing support.

More about G2O

We’re different than other companies at G2O. We blend the research and design, technology, and data expertise to deliver the solutions our clients crave — and we do all of this as one in-house team, from vision to execution. We’re also the largest company of our kind based in Ohio to do this — and have been evolving how we do it for 40 years.

Individually, we bring a wealth of experience from diverse backgrounds — personally and in business. We’re a diverse and passionate team of leaders and experts in technology, data,
analytics, design, content, and more. But we think we’re best when we put our minds together. Each person brings something distinct to our team — some unique flavor to their background or their experience. That makes for stronger collaboration — and elevates the outcomes for our clients.

Are you ready to collaborate to greatness with us?
Learn more at G2O.com/careers
