jobs.title: Business Analyst - Corporate Change
jobs.description:
The Role

The Corporate Change team in Europe is hiring a Business Analyst to support strategic and regulatory change initiatives with a focus on a key Know Your Customer (KYC) project. This role involves collaborating across multiple departments to translate complex business needs into actionable solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of Vanguard's European transformation agenda, helping shape and deliver initiatives that have a meaningful impact across the business. As a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, project managers and business leaders, you will play a key role in turning complex challenges into practical, value-driven solutions.

Your initial focus will be a strategically important Know Your Customer (KYC) programme, working across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Technology and the broader business to help define requirements, solve problems and drive delivery. Beyond this, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a diverse portfolio of strategic and operational change initiatives across Vanguard Europe.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys getting to the root of complex problems, bringing structure to ambiguity and influencing outcomes through analysis, collaboration and stakeholder engagement. You will work closely with Senior Project Managers, gaining exposure to senior leaders across the organisation while building expertise in business analysis, change delivery and transformation.

We are looking for an individual who is intellectually curious, motivated to challenge the status quo and excited by the opportunity to make a tangible impact. The successful candidate will be a proactive problem solver, a strong relationship builder and someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

This role offers an excellent development opportunity for someone looking to broaden their network, deepen their understanding of Vanguard's European business and play an important role in shaping how we deliver change across the organisation.

In this role you will

Partner closely with Project and Senior Project Managers to support the successful delivery of change initiatives through business analysis, requirements gathering, current and future state assessments, risk management, delivery assurance and issue resolution
Find and propose creative ways to solve problems and work closely with internal and external teams to evaluate business opportunities, documenting requirements and areas for improvement
Analyse business processes, systems, data and operating models to identify dependencies, assess impacts and support the design and implementation of effective business solutions
Partner with internal and external teams to develop and maintain project documentation, artefacts and deliverables required to support successful project execution
Align to the project manager to be an advocate for change, by clearly articulating the benefits and promoting acceptance, across functional team members and leadership teams, of ‘to-be’ models and frameworks
Be able to estimate effort for requirement elicitation and analysis across projects
Ensure all analysis, deliverables and recommendations align with business objectives and Vanguard's change management standards, frameworks and methodologies
Define and document the requirements for system integrations and assist in implementing solutions

What It Takes

Demonstrable experience in using tools, data analysis, documentation and strategic problem solving to successfully progress projects to completion
Previous experience in the wealth industry ideally KYC, AML, Client Onboarding or Financial Crime programmes is beneficial but not required
Excellent written, visual, and verbal communications skills, able to influence and negotiate whilst showing business judgment and work ethic
Diligence with strong organisational, interpersonal and relationship management skills
Ability to deliver multiple concurrent projects and manage competing priorities

Special Factors

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position
This is a hybrid position and would require you to work in the office 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday)
Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close this role early if there is a high level of interest. To avoid missing out, we recommend applying as soon as possible

Why Vanguard?

Vanguard is a different kind of investment company. It was founded in the United States in 1975 on a simple but revolutionary idea: that an investment company should manage its funds solely in the interests of its clients.

This is a philosophy that has helped millions of people around the world to achieve their goals with low-cost, uncomplicated investments.

It's what we stand for: value to investors.

Inclusion Statement

Vanguard’s continued commitment to diversity and inclusion is firmly rooted in our culture. Every decision we make to best serve our clients, crew (internally employees are referred to as crew), and communities is guided by one simple statement: “Do the right thing.” 

We believe that a critical aspect of doing the right thing requires building diverse, inclusive, and highly effective teams of individuals who are as unique as the clients they serve. We empower our crew to contribute their distinct strengths to achieving Vanguard’s core purpose through our values. 

When all crew members feel valued and included, our ability to collaborate and innovate is amplified, and we are united in delivering on Vanguard's core purpose: to take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

This organization builds and operationalize enterprise‑scale data, analytics, and AI capabilities that do more than inform decisions—they reshape how HR plans, predicts, personalizes, and performs. We are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to help shape how Salla builds and improves products through data. You will partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, and the Data team to turn customer behaviour and product performance into clear decisions.

You will own analytics for a product area end to end, from defining success metrics and measurement plans to analysing experiments, monitoring launches, and recommending next steps. This role is ideal for an experienced analyst who combines strong technical skills with product judgement.

Salla's products are complex and operate at scale. You will often face questions without an existing playbook, which means learning the domain quickly, synthesising across messy and incomplete inputs, and deciding what level of analysis is enough for the decision at hand. Knowing when to go deeper and when to move forward matters as much as the analysis itself. This role suits someone who is comfortable making calls with incomplete information and moving fast without losing rigour.

Responsibilities

Partner with product teams to translate questions and hypotheses into clear KPIs and success criteria
Own analytics across key product journeys, including funnels, feature adoption, engagement, conversion, retention, and segmentation
Conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose performance changes, uncover root causes, and recommend product opportunities
Design and analyse A/B tests and impact evaluations, including metric selection, guardrails, validation checks, and decision recommendations
Develop and validate tracking plans for new features
Measure product launches and build dashboards and self-serve tools for monitoring product health
Communicate findings, business impact, and trade-offs clearly while contributing to team best practices and supporting junior analysts

Requirements

4+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, or a related role within a technology or digital-product environment
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets
Strong understanding of product metrics, including funnels, cohorts, conversion, retention, and feature adoption
Hands-on experience with product experiments and a solid understanding of hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical power, and common A/B-testing pitfalls
Experience with event-based product data, tracking plans, implementation validation, and data-quality checks
Proficiency with a BI tool such as Looker, Metabase, or Tableau, plus working knowledge of Python or R
Strong product judgement and the ability to manage analytical work independently in ambiguous situations
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence product decisions through data

Nice to Have

Proficiency in Arabic and experience working in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC
Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, fintech, or SaaS products

Wir entwickeln unsere moderne Data-Warehouse-Architektur von Grund auf neu. Heißt: aus rohen Zahlen wertvolle Erkenntnisse machen, mit denen das ganze Unternehmen bessere Entscheidungen trifft. Du musst dafür kein fertiger Profi sein – Du musst Lust haben, Dich reinzudenken.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
This is a newly created role sitting at the intersection of Commercial Finance, Growth and Technology. The successful candidate will become the go-to person for turning raw data into reporting and trend analysis that drives commercial and growth decision-making across the business, spanning customer, membership, trade, and operational performance.

This role is being created at a pivotal moment. We are in a high growth stage, mid-migration to a new data warehouse, consolidating reporting across all of our systems. Today, extracting meaningful reporting requires heavy SQL work directly against individual data hubs. This person will play a central role in shaping the accuracy, structure, and reporting logic of the new data warehouse as it is finalised, acting as commercial and reporting-accuracy support on that project. Getting this right is fundamental to how fast and how well we make growth decisions as the business scales, so this directly underpins Growth, not just Technology.

Over time, there is a genuine opportunity for this role to grow, both in scope and, as the business scales, into a wider data and reporting team. This is a foundational hire.

You'll be mentored closely by the Commercial Finance and Strategy Director, who owns the Growth function and will steer commercial and growth priorities, while you bring the technical depth and cross-functional connection to make the data usable, trusted, and actionable.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting & Trend Analysis

Own, create and evolve regular reporting across customer, membership, trade, and operational performance
Build and maintain trend analysis that helps Commercial Finance and Strategic Growth and wider leadership understand business performance and emerging patterns
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear, accurate data outputs
Define and track relevant KPIs for an ecommerce/app-based, membership-driven business

Data Warehouse Project

Partner across the reporting and data-accuracy voice within the data warehouse migration project, working closely with Technology
Support validating that the data structures, definitions, and outputs being built will meet commercial and finance reporting needs
Support the finalisation of the warehouse from an accuracy and usability standpoint, tracking progress, flagging risks, and helping ensure reconciliation and accuracy are maintained
Support the transition from current SQL-heavy, hub-by-hub reporting to a universally accepted data source used for strategic decision making by the SLT and management

Systems & Technical

Develop and maintain a strong working understanding of our current systems and data hubs, including the SQL required to extract and interpret data from them
Work confidently with SQL in the interim (pre-warehouse) environment, and help define reporting logic and data models for the future state
Flag data quality issues, inconsistencies, or gaps proactively

Cross-Functional Communication

Act as a translator between technical/data concepts and commercial stakeholders across the business
Build relationships with teams outside Finance and Tech to understand their reporting needs and pain points
Present findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical audiences, including SLT

Essential

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Strong SQL skills and confidence working directly with data hubs/systems rather than pre-built dashboards alone
Proven experience building reporting and trend analysis in a commercial or finance context
Excellent communication skills, able to work equally well with Technology and with non-technical commercial teams
A genuine interest in and understanding of KPIs relevant to an ecommerce/app-based business
Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity. This is a new role in a business that is actively building its data infrastructure
Self-starter mentality with the judgement to know when to lead and when to seek guidance from the Commercial Finance Director

Desirable (not Essential, But a Strong Plus)

Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
Experience in fashion, luxury fashion, membership, or subscription-based businesses
Exposure to data warehouse migrations or reporting infrastructure projects
Experience with BI/visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker, Tableau)

WHY THIS ROLE

A rare opportunity to shape both the reporting output and the underlying data infrastructure of a growing luxury fashion group
Direct mentorship and close working relationship with the Commercial Finance Director
Genuine potential to grow this role into a team as the business scales
Visibility across customer, membership, trade, and operational functions. This role is central to how the business understands itself

Benefits

Why Join MILE

Opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of the company
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organisation

Let's build something people talk about. Together.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Inference Performance
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Technical Program Manager for Inference, you'll be the critical bridge between our inference systems and the broader organization. You'll drive strategic initiatives across inference runtime and accelerator performance—coordinating model launches, managing cross-platform dependencies, and ensuring reliability across multiple hardware targets. This role is essential for keeping our most contended infrastructure teams shipping effectively while Research, Product, and Safety all depend on their output.

Responsibilities

Systems Integration & Coordination: Lead cross-functional initiatives for new infrastructure integration, establishing clear ownership, timelines, and communication channels between teams. Drive end-to-end planning for major infrastructure transitions including platform modernization and new tech adoption.
Performance & Efficiency: Partner with engineering teams to identify optimization opportunities, track performance metrics, and prioritize work that unlocks capacity gains. Coordinate across runtime and accelerator layers to ensure efficiency wins ship without compromising reliability.
Launch Coordination: Drive end-to-end readiness for model and feature launches across multiple hardware platforms. Establish processes for cross-platform validation, manage launch timelines, and ensure smooth handoffs between runtime, accelerator, and downstream teams.
Strategic Planning: Own and prioritize the inference deployment roadmap, working closely with engineering leadership to prioritize initiatives and manage dependencies. Provide visibility into upcoming changes and their organizational impact.
Stakeholder Communication: Build strong relationships across research, engineering, and product teams to understand requirements and constraints. Translate technical complexities into clear updates for leadership and ensure alignment on priorities and timelines.
Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in current workflows and drive systematic improvements. Establish metrics and dashboards to track infrastructure health, capacity utilization, and deployment success rates.

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have several years of experience in technical program management, with proven success delivering complex infrastructure programs, preferably in ML/AI systems or large-scale distributed systems
Have deep technical understanding of inference systems, compilers, or hardware accelerators to engage substantively with engineers and identify technical risks.
Excel at creating structure and processes in ambiguous environments, bringing clarity to complex cross-team initiatives
Have strong stakeholder management skills and can build trust with both technical and non-technical partners
Are comfortable navigating competing priorities and using data to drive technical decisions
Have experience with infrastructure scaling initiatives, hardware integrations, or deployment governance
Thrive in fast-paced environments and can balance strategic planning with tactical execution
Are passionate about AI infrastructure and understand the unique challenges of deploying and scaling large language models

Deadline to apply:
None, applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$290,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Funds Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Founders Pledge, our mission is to empower entrepreneurs to do immense good with their charitable giving. Since launching in 2015, our community of over 2,300 members has pledged nearly $13.6B and donated $1.9B+ to the charitable sector in 45+ countries.

We provide end-to-end giving infrastructure, pioneering research, and access to a global network of experts. In other words, we help tech leaders become strategic philanthropists. Our members include founders and leaders behind companies such as Airbnb, UiPath, Dropbox, Skype, Spotify, and Uber.

We focus on deploying capital where it can achieve the greatest impact, guided by evidence, careful analysis, and long-term thinking.

Salary: Up to $90,000 DOE

About The Role

Founders Pledge primarily funds high-impact opportunities through direct donations from our members or through our themed Funds. Growing and effectively managing these Funds is a massive priority for us. They allow us to deploy capital quickly in time-sensitive moments, leverage deep domain expertise, and unlock additional resources through innovative funding mechanisms.

As our Funds play a larger role in how we move capital and shape new solutions, we need a dedicated Funds Program Manager, who will be the central engine room for our Fund Managers - taking on the operational weight of fundraising execution, fixing data workflows, and keeping information flowing flawlessly across our teams.

Reporting to our Research Operations Lead, we’re looking for someone adept at operations who can build, implement and improve robust systems, ensuring our funding infrastructure matches our global ambition. You’ll also provide operational and administrative support to our Fund Managers and the research team, to help our team scale their impact.

What You’ll Do

Each fund is currently managed by a dedicated Fund Manager, focused on growth enablement and execution. As Funds Program Manager, you’ll have three primary focus areas:

Own Fundraising Operations & Data Systems

Your Main Goal Will Be To Make The Operational Process Of Fund Fundraising Entirely Seamless, Moving Money Efficiently And Tracking The Metrics That Drive Growth. To Achieve This, You’ll

Build and scale our systems: Take our current ad-hoc processes and replace them with centralized, robust tracking systems for all quantitative and qualitative fund data (commitments, capital inflows/outflows, and fund performance). You’ll identify strategic or operational bottlenecks and recommend improvements to aid fund scalability.
Master the pipeline metrics: Pull data out of silos. You’ll map and balance our donor pipeline against our research pipeline of High-Impact Funding Opportunities (HIFOs) - ensuring capital supply smoothly matches disbursement demand.
Streamline grantmaking mechanics: Co-own the end-to-end coordination of Fund operations - including grant tracking, timelines, committee coordination, approvals, and disbursements - so our Research team/Fund Managers spend zero unnecessary time on admin.
Anticipate bottlenecks: You’ll proactively surface risks to senior leadership (e.g. delays in research sign-off, capital shortfalls, execution constraints).
Manage one-off donor and funder requests: This could include tailored reporting, special conditions, or agreement-related obligations, ensuring responsiveness and follow-through.

2. Drive Internal Coordination & Information Flow

You’ll eliminate any operational friction between our Fund Managers, Research teams, and the public-facing Communications and Member Experience teams.

Bridge the gap to Communications: Act as the operational connective tissue to ensure fund materials, external posts, internal memos, and impact reports are accurate, timely, and aligned. You won’t create these materials yourself, but will collaborate to ensure our communications assist our disbursement targets.
Manage donor commitments: Work closely with our Impact Analytics team to coordinate external reporting, smoothly managing one-off donor requests and special conditions so that we deliver flawlessly on our promises.
Support high-stakes launches: Coordinate internal functional areas to execute fund launches and reopenings. To start, you’ll dive right into project managing the relaunch of our Animal Welfare Fund.

3. Provide Administrative and Operational Support

Some of your time will be spent providing operational and administrative support to Fund Managers to allow them to focus on their primary responsibilities.

Administrative support: this work may include email drafting and management (including prioritization support), scheduling meetings, helping prepare for meetings, conferences, and follow-ups, as well as booking flights, hotels, and meeting rooms.
Operational support: assist the Research Operations Lead by taking on repeatable, process-driven work, building operational and organizational fluency along the way.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with operations experience, ideally in the field of philanthropy or non-profits. You’re someone who loves optimization, gets satisfaction from making things run smoothly, and has the confidence to implement new systems rather than just maintaining the status quo.

You’ll Have

Operational experience: You bring significant experience managing complex operations, multi-stakeholder projects or data pipelines - ideally in grantmaking, consulting, or a fast-moving nonprofit environment.
Ecosystem experience: You have direct experience working with philanthropic Funds, in grantmaking operations, philanthropic services or a foundation/donor-advised fund context. You already understand how capital moves in our ecosystem.
A systems-builder mindset: You don't wait for a process to be given to you. You’re highly fluent with the tools that underpin this work (like Salesforce, Notion, Asana, or Google Workspace) and know how to use them to reduce organizational friction.
High attention to detail: You know that in grantmaking, a small error in tracking or disbursement directly erodes donor trust. You take pride in flawless accuracy.
Clear, proactive communication: You can hold many threads at once, translate messy pipeline data into clean insights, and proactively surface risks to leadership before they become bottlenecks.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities: you can handle multiple projects/stakeholders at once and manage directional changes with ease. You initiate ways to help instead of waiting to be told.

Location and Travel Requirements

This role is based in either NY or SF, with one day in the office.

Occasional travel may be required for team offsites (once per year), and all staff are expected to attend a global offsite annually.

Application Deadline

Applications will be accepted until EOD 14th September.

Why Work With Us?

You can find more about the benefits we offer here, but what makes us truly special is both our mission and our people.

We’re a diverse team, from both charitable and commercial backgrounds, who believe that amazing things can happen when we tackle problems together.

We offer a flat structure and an opportunity to help shape the future of philanthropy.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Founders Pledge. We seek people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who share our drive to understand and solve complex social challenges.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Finding solutions to the world’s most pressing problems requires different perspectives and unique ways of thinking, and we are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone can do their best work.

If you’re excited about our mission but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About The Role

You'll drive cross-functional execution of Anthropic's data center programs from construction through commissioning and day-to-day operations. Partnering with our Data Center and Compute teams, you'll own the program management that delivers buildings on time ready for production workloads. As we scale beyond our first sites, you'll focus on accelerating construction and deployment, building repeatable playbooks, and driving continuous improvement across our growing footprint.

Manage and develop the DC infrastructure TPM team; hire and build out the function as we scale
Lead program reviews and executive communications on delivery status, risks, and blockers
Drive construction-to-production execution across multiple sites, coordinating with partners, contractors, and internal teams
Own overall schedule tracking, risk identification, and mitigation; creating clear visibility for leadership
Align with energy and location strategy and support site selection and due diligence criteria to facilitate scaling well in advance of aggressive compute demand
Manage long pole dependencies and long-lead time development & procurement across a dynamically changing global marketplace
Partner with DC and Compute teams to drive handover criteria between site completion, equipment deployment, and operations
Coordinate with Infrastructure, Security, and Compliance teams on evolving requirements; versioning, optimization, and expansion across sites
Drive partner accountability on contractual milestones and commercial commitments
Coordinate equipment delivery and manage vendor accountability on schedules; tracking production and shipping milestones while maintaining productive partnerships
Build repeatable processes and playbooks that scale across multiple concurrent site deployments
Travel (20%) to sites to validate progress and build contractor relationships

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have 7+ years in data center construction, operations, or infrastructure program management at hyperscale or critical infrastructure companies
Have management experience building and leading TPM or program management teams
Have led multi-site infrastructure programs with compressed timelines and complex cross-functional dependencies among multiple partners and vendors
Excel at aligning multiple partners, vendors, and internal engineering teams around shared deliverables
Can bridge physical infrastructure and software/security teams
Thrive in ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information under schedule pressure
Communicate complex program status clearly to executives

Deadline to apply:
None applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$365,000—$435,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Public Sector Deployment Strategist team at TRM Labs is dedicated to ensuring government and regulatory customers achieve their desired outcomes with TRM's blockchain intelligence platform. As a Deployment Strategist focused on the regulator segment, you will serve as a trusted advisor for regulatory agencies — driving adoption, onboarding, and retention across a critical and growing customer base. This position requires US Citizenship.

The Impact You Will Have

Act as a trusted advisor for regulator customers, helping them maximize the effectiveness of TRM’s blockchain intelligence tools within their compliance, enforcement, and investigative workflows.
Onboard new regulator customers and drive utilization milestones within 60 days, tailoring training and enablement to each agency’s unique regulatory mandate.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with economic buyers at regulator agencies, connecting them to TRM executive leadership within the first 90 days.
Develop and launch self-serve resources (regulator playbooks, onboarding guides, FAQ copilots) to scale support and reduce time to value across the regulator segment.
Identify recurring regulator use cases and deliver scalable solutions (chatbots, workflow templates, standard query sets) that can be reused across multiple customers.
Monitor customer usage, detect adoption gaps, and execute proactively to maintain ~90%+ retention and identify expansion opportunities.
Serve as the Voice of the Customer for the regulator segment, surfacing product feedback and feature requests to Product and Engineering.

What We're Looking For

3–5+ years of experience working directly within or alongside government regulatory agencies - or in customer success, deployment, consulting, or account management roles where the primary customer base was government or regulatory bodies.
Practical experience with or strong interest in blockchain analysis, virtual currencies, and investigative/compliance tools.
Experience structuring problems and identifying the most critical issues to prioritize in complex regulatory environments.
Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively for technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.
Demonstrated AI fluency — ability to build and deploy workflow-driven AI solutions (e.g., copilots, automated trackers, bots) beyond basic summarization.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, remote-first environment where priorities can shift quickly.
US Citizenship required.

About The Team

The Public Sector DS team is a small, high-impact group covering multiple public sector segments, including regulators — serving some of TRM’s most strategically important customers.
Fully remote and globally distributed, with most overlap between 7am–5pm PT for meetings and collaboration.
The team thrives on asynchronous communication via Slack and Notion, with weekly customer syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, and regular POD calls.
As regulator interest grows across TRM’s product suite, this role is at the forefront of expansion into the regulatory segment.
The team culture is mission-driven, customer-obsessed, and operates with TRM Speed — delivering V1 solutions fast and iterating based on feedback.

Team Operating Rhythms

Weekly customer syncs with assigned accounts
Bi-weekly health syncs with DS team and leadership
Weekly POD calls with aligned Sales AEs
Weekly hiring sync with Recruiter (during active hiring)
Async daily standups via Slack

On-Call Responsibilities

Limited on-call responsibilities including one weekend on‑call per month after ramp, monitoring Slack about every two hours for P0/P1 issues

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

Self-Serve Resource Launch: Develop and launch self-serve resources (e.g., regulator playbooks, onboarding guides, or templates) within 2–3 weeks to reduce time to value and scale support across customers.
Scalable Regulator Solution: Identify a recurring regulator use case and deliver a scalable solution (e.g., chatbot, workflow template, or standard query set) within 30 days that can be reused across multiple customers.
Executive Relationship: Establish an economic buyer relationship within the first 60 days for new accounts, and connect that stakeholder to at least one TRM executive or senior leader within the first 90 days.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate
Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organisation makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centres driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

About The Role

As a Senior Project Manager, you will take lead for the successful delivery and commercial performance of complex multidisciplinary projects and programmes. You will provide leadership to project teams, manage strategic client relationships, oversee project governance and ensure delivery of technical, programme and commercial objectives. You will act as a senior representative of the business, leading project delivery strategy, supporting business growth and ensuring projects contribute positively to operational and financial performance. In addition, you will mentor project managers and contribute to the development and continuous improvement of project delivery practices across the business

About You

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager with demonstrable leadership experience managing multidisciplinary project teams across complex projects and programmes. Someone with strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance technical, operational and financial priorities, with proven ability to influence, negotiate and build consensus across clients, stakeholders and project teams. You will have a strong decision-making and problem-solving capability within complex delivery environments and experience in developing and mentoring project managers and technical professionals.

Responsibilities

Support the Area Business Group Manager and leadership team in the effective operation and strategic development of the business.
Promote and champion the implementation of HDR project management, commercial, quality and risk management processes.
Contribute to business planning activities including workload forecasting, resource planning and operational improvement initiatives.
Support the development, mentoring and performance management of Project Managers and project delivery staff.
Participate in recruitment, talent development, succession planning and retention activities as required.
Encourage technical excellence, innovation and adoption of best practice across all project teams.
Provide support and guidance in project reviews, project recovery plans and resolution of complex delivery challenges.
Contribute to bid reviews, project pursuits and mobilisation activities for major opportunities.
Promote collaboration across business groups, disciplines and geographic regions to maximise value for clients and the business.
Support the continuous development of project management standards, procedures, templates and lessons learned programmes.
Undertake project audits, governance reviews and quality assurance activities as required.
Ensure compliance with HDR Quality Management Systems, environmental management procedures and all applicable company policies.
Champion a culture of safety, integrity, accountability and continuous improvement.
Represent HDR professionally within industry forums, client organisations and professional institutions.
Perform other duties as required to support the successful operation and growth of the business.

Requirements

Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years relevant industry experience, including significant experience delivering multidisciplinary engineering or consultancy projects.
Demonstrable experience in a Senior Project Manager leadership role.
Professional registration or chartership in a relevant discipline (CEng, IEng or equivalent) preferred.
Project management qualification such as APM PMQ, ChPP, PMP or equivalent desirable.
Proven track record of managing complex projects with responsibility for technical, programme and commercial performance.
Experience managing projects through all phases of the project lifecycle from bid through delivery and closeout.
Experience of contract administration, commercial management and change control processes.
Experience of leading multidisciplinary teams and managing external consultants and contractors.
Commitment to continuous professional development and active participation in HDR's employee-owned culture.

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. The organization's mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. The initial focus was on solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The administrative work – credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation – is complex. Automation has been implemented to address this.

The organization is going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on the software, serving over 1 million patients. The goal is to build the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagine the experience of finding a therapist, and invest in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. This is more than just a billing layer; it is becoming the platform where care actually happens.

This is a Series D organization with significant funding, looking for exceptional people to help achieve this mission. The aim is for time spent here to be the most meaningful experience of one's career. Joining this team means helping to change mental healthcare for the better.

As the organization works to build a new mental healthcare system that everyone can access, it is facing unique operational challenges and opportunities that come with growing and scaling at an unparalleled rate. The boundaries of the existing healthcare system are being pushed to fulfill the promise to providers, patients, and payers to create access to high-quality providers across the nation. To achieve this, a world-class operations team is being built to enable efficiency, growth, and quality. As a member of this team, there will be an opportunity to have a material impact on the trajectory of the organization and help define a function core to the livelihood of the business and the impact delivered for partners and clients.

As a Business Operations Manager, the individual will lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that span teams and pods. This role will operate as a thought partner to Product, Data, and Operations leaders – helping shape objectives, influence priorities, and translate complex insights into actionable plans. In addition to owning critical operational workflows, the individual will design scalable systems, mentor team members, and drive initiatives that create durable, measurable impact across the organization. This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to drive alignment and execution across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Design and build foundations for a variety of 0-1 initiatives within the Business Operations function.
Collaborate cross-functionally to build, execute, monitor, and implement scalable products and processes that enable the organization to deliver on core business challenges.
Assess and analyze data to develop and determine strategies for accelerating progress, proactively identify areas for improvement, and deliver on roadmap priorities and team OKRs.
Build and manage a growing team to achieve these objectives.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in operational roles at high-growth companies, with some background in consulting or finance, business operations preferred but not required.
Data is a first language; enjoyment and skill in digging through complex data to solve ambiguous problems.
Thrives in the unknown, seeking out opportunities to dive into unfamiliar challenges, drive towards outcomes, and shape strategy.
Operationally excellent, able to manage a large volume of moving pieces without breaking a sweat.
A collaborator that proactively partners across teams while holding teams accountable for business results.
Seeks an environment that fosters individual growth through open feedback and high autonomy.
Motivated by the opportunity to make an impact on one of the generation's defining problems: affordable mental healthcare.

Compensation and Benefits

The expected base pay range for this position is $121,600 - $190,000. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an equity grant, depending on the position and level.

The organization is committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

Benefits offered include:

The strength of a team is in its people, and the mission cannot be achieved without a team that reflects the diversity of the problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Behind every report, every market trend, and every business decision our clients make is trusted, high-quality data. As a Data Operations Analyst, you'll play a key role in making that happen.

Working within NIQ's global Operations function, you'll ensure market data is accurate, complete, and ready for delivery to some of the world's most recognized brands. You'll investigate data issues, validate information, and help maintain the quality standards our clients rely on.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Middle)
jobs.description:
Build like a founder. Ship like Spartan.

Our clients are startups in a race: an MVP in 30 days, one demo away from a funding round. We’re looking for a Technical PM to run that race and keep every piece on track.
We don’t act like vendors. We embed. Our teams sit inside startups backed by YC, Pear VC, BlingCap, a16z, and Techstars, working beside founders and engineers from Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, and Uber. Together we ship those MVPs and scale the systems behind them to millions of users and billions of requests.
This isn’t a ticket-pushing PM role. You are the person a US founder calls when they need the truth about their product. You own scope, timeline, quality, and the client relationship. The engineers build. You make sure the right thing ships, on time, and the client knows exactly where things stand. And the Technical in the title is real: you read the architecture, question the estimates, and hold your own in an engineering discussion.
70% of our portfolio is LLM-powered. You’ll scope AI features, plan around model risk, and use Cursor and Claude yourself to write specs and plans faster.

Who Thrives at Spartan
Not every environment fits everyone, so here’s an honest picture of the teammate we’re looking for.
You’ll thrive here if:
You own the outcome: scope, timeline, quality, and the relationship.
You’re technical enough that engineers can’t hand-wave you, and clear enough that founders never feel lost.
You can tell a founder no, with a reason and a plan.
You wear many hats without being asked: PM today, BA tomorrow, QA on release day.
You step into an at-risk project and bring it back to green.

Some weeks will stretch you. That’s the job. But you’ll never carry it alone. A critical client release or a hard founder conversation? The team is right there with you. We push each other hard because we care how far each of us can go. We win together. We lose together. Nobody gets left behind.
One last thing. We’re not filling seats. We’re looking for teammates for the battles ahead. If you read all this and something in you said yes, trust that feeling and apply. We respect people who back themselves. Every Spartan here started with that same yes.

What You’ll Do
Own delivery of client engagements end to end: scope, estimate, timeline, quality.
Be the daily voice to US startup founders. Run async standups, write sharp status updates, deliver bad news early and with a plan.
Turn vague founder ideas into PRDs and RFCs the team can ship in 30 days.
Scope AI features with clear eyes: what the model can do today, what needs a spike, and how to demo it honestly.
Plan AI work differently: prototype first, define evals early, budget for iteration.
Read the tech. Challenge estimates. Discuss architecture trade-offs with your Team Lead, then explain them to the founder in business language.
Track project health (Green / Yellow / Red), raise risks before they blow up, escalate with options, not problems.
Run the delivery process: sprints, code review SLAs, release plans, demos.
Support pre-sales: feasibility checks and estimates for new deals.
Wear whatever hat the project needs to win.

What We’re Looking For
Fluent English, spoken and written. You talk to US founders every day.
An engineering background. You’ve written production code, or worked close enough to it that a padded estimate can’t get past you.
3+ years running software delivery at an agency, consulting firm, or startup. That means you owned the projects, not just attended the standups.
You’ve told a client something they didn’t want to hear, and kept the contract.
You can persuade a non-technical founder to invest two sprints in tech debt, in their language, not jargon.
You work AI-native: Cursor, Claude, Codex. You use AI to plan, write, and move faster.
An owner’s mindset. You own outcomes, not tickets.

Nice to Have
Experience shipping LLM-powered products.
Experience with US or other Western clients.
Hands-on backend or frontend experience you can still use in a pinch.

Tools We Use
Notion · Slack · Linear · Jira · GitHub · Figma Cursor · Claude · Codex

Career Growth
Work directly with founders from YC, Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, Uber, and more.
Exposure to how AI products get scoped, built, and launched across many startup domains.
Transparent career path and mentorship from engineers who’ve taken 3 companies to IPO.
Every project feels like its own mini-startup.

Why Spartan
50+ MVPs launched, 3 IPOs, $100M+ raised by the startups we build with.
95% engineer retention. People stay because the work is worth staying for.
You take products zero to one. From a founder’s idea to a live launch in weeks. Most PMs get that chance once in a career. Here it’s the job.
Your work is visible. The product you run this month is in a founder’s investor demo next month.
No layers, no bureaucracy. You talk to the decision-maker directly, and decisions land in hours, not weeks.
Every project is a new market, a new team, a new problem. One year here teaches what three years elsewhere would.
You’ll never just take tickets. You’ll own problems, ship fast, and grow with the founders we partner with.

Benefits & Perks
💰 Competitive salary, 100% salary during probation
🏝 Unlimited PTO + public holidays
🩺 Premium healthcare insurance + annual health check
⚽ Sports clubs for every taste: football, badminton, billiards, pickleball

🏠 Hybrid working style, flexible hours
✈️ Annual company trip + monthly team parties
💻 MacBook provided

Te Haeata/The Opportunity

The Business Analyst
is a Fixed Term Full Time opportuinity until 30 May 2029
responsible for working collaboratively with business stakeholders, programme teams, digital service teams, technical specialists, and vendors to understand, analyse, and document business, information, reporting, analytics, and data requirements.

Reporting to the Manager Te Au Reka Data Enablement, the Business Analyst acts as a conduit between business units, organisational stakeholders, and Te Au Reka delivery teams. The role develops a strong understanding of current business operations, future objectives, and information needs, then translates these into clear requirements and recommendations that support reporting, analytics, insights, and data-enabled decision-making.

Working within a complex transformation environment, the Business Analyst supports the delivery of high-quality, fit-for-purpose data and information solutions by analysing business services, processes, organisational structures, information flows, and reporting requirements. The role works closely with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and to ensure that data, reporting, and analytics capabilities align with business outcomes and operational needs.

The role supports stakeholder engagement and change activities that may result in improvements to business services, reporting processes, information management practices, data governance, and service delivery mechanisms. This may also include supporting the introduction of new digital solutions, automation opportunities, and analytics capabilities that enhance organisational performance and decision-making.

As part of the Data Enablement team, the Business Analyst plays an important role in ensuring Te Au Reka delivers enduring value through trusted data, meaningful insights, and sustainable information capabilities.

You will enjoy working in transformational programmes of work, be experienced in managing ambiguity and value diversity of thought while respecting culture and traditions. You will contribute to creating an inclusive work environment where differences are acknowledged and respected, contributing to a strong team that delivers in a positive environment. If you thrive on delivering business outcomes and ensuring customer-centric service design is applied to everything you do, we want to hear from you!

Data quality, completeness, and reconciliation requirements are identified and addressed.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation
jobs.description:
Position:
Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation, Byram Township, NJ Posted:
06/10/2026

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. The culture of our company is one of working together to achieve our clients’ objectives, company goals and employee’s professional goals and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, Vanguard retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home.

CAPE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We invite all qualified applicants to apply to our open positions.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Networks
jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager | Infrastructure Network Engineering | Fully Remote, United States

A global organisation is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of infrastructure network programmes across one of the most operationally critical environments in the world.

You will run deployment and retrofit programmes from initial planning through to handoff, coordinating across network engineering, supply chain, and operations teams to ensure management and facility network infrastructure lands on time, on spec, and ready to operate.
The programmes you will own are the backbone of data centre resilience.

Not the production network - the infrastructure that lets engineers monitor, manage, control, and recover everything else. Out-of-band connectivity, facility networks, disaster recovery backbone, device management networks, and the security layer that protects them all. When something goes wrong in a data centre, these are the systems that make recovery possible.

If you have managed large-scale infrastructure network deployments, understand the difference between a plan of record and what actually happens on site, and know how to hold vendors and partners accountable without burning the relationship, this role is built for you.

What you will own

Own end-to-end programme delivery across network deployments globally. New builds, retrofits, and end-of-life hardware replacements. You set the programme plan, define milestones, manage the critical path, and hold every stakeholder accountable to it.
Translate strategic roadmaps into executable delivery plans. You will lead H1 and H2 planning cycles and turn a twelve-month supply execution plan into a weekly operating reality across vendors, engineers, and operations teams.
Drive hardware and supply chain accountability. You will ensure BOMs are ordered correctly and on time, track hardware deliveries to site, manage Hardware Need-By Dates across multiple internal teams, and identify long-lead procurement risks before they become programme blockers.
Manage cross-functional dependencies across network engineering, supply chain, security, and operations. You will not wait for problems to surface. You will find them early, escalate fast, and drive resolution.
Establish and maintain programme governance. Programme trackers, status decks, risk registers, executive reporting, and lessons learned reviews are yours. Leadership should never be surprised by what is happening in your programme.

What you need

Proven programme management rigour in a complex infrastructure environment. You have managed multi-workstream programmes with hard deadlines, held vendors and engineering teams accountable, and made decisions under pressure when ambiguity was high and the schedule could not slip.
Hands-on experience managing infrastructure network deployments in a data centre or mission-critical environment. You understand what it takes to get management and facility network infrastructure from design through commissioning and operational handoff. You know what breaks, why it breaks, and how to prevent it.
Technical fluency across management and operational network infrastructure. You do not need to be a network engineer but you need to hold your own in conversations about out-of-band connectivity, facility networks, device management, and DR backbone architecture. You ask the right questions and recognise when the answers do not add up.
Hardware and BOM management experience. You have managed equipment procurement at scale - tracking lead times, coordinating deliveries, and ensuring the right hardware is on site when the programme needs it. End-of-life and end-of-support retrofit experience is a strong plus.
Vendor and contractor accountability. You have managed multi-vendor delivery environments where no single team owns the entire critical path. You know how to keep external partners aligned, escalate when needed, and maintain the relationship through difficult conversations.
Risk identification and programme health management. You maintain a live risk register, proactively surface issues to leadership, and run lessons learned reviews that actually change how the next programme runs.

What will set you apart

Prior experience managing infrastructure network deployments inside a hyperscaler or large-scale data centre environment.
Familiarity with out-of-band management networks, facility systems including power and environmental monitoring, disaster recovery backbone networking, or PON technology in a data centre context.
Experience managing the full hardware lifecycle from BOM generation and procurement through delivery, staging, installation, and decommissioning including end-of-life replacement programmes.
Background in supply chain coordination or capacity planning for infrastructure programmes where long-lead hardware is on the critical path.
Experience building and running a Tactical Plan of Record or equivalent twelve-month supply execution planning process.
Phased rollout experience across new build, retrofit, and end-of-life replacement programme types simultaneously across multiple global sites.

If interested, please apply with your most up-to-date CV & I’ll be in touch!
